items.title: 台股漲693點外資轉買超562億元掃貨電子代工 狂敲國巨*逾百億元
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks Rise 693 Points as Foreign Investors Flip to Net Buying of NT$56.2 B, Snatching Up Electronics OEMs and Buying Over NT$10 B of Yageo
paras: 台股今(4)日上漲693點，外資由連2賣轉為買超562億元，但台指期淨空單增加880口來到8.23萬口，期現貨再度不同調。個股方面，外資掃貨電子代工族群並大買國巨*102億元，調節面板雙虎、封測族群。
外資今日大買電子代工族群，仁寶6.94萬張、鴻海2.64萬張、緯創2.39萬張、英業達1.34萬張、廣達1.28萬張、聯電2.66萬張、國巨*1.85萬張、宏碁1.43萬張、鼎元1.12萬張，金融股則以第一金1.43萬張、兆豐金1.30萬張較多。
ETF方面，外資買超較多的有主動統一升級50(00403A) 3.40萬張、元大台灣50正2(00631L) 1.88萬張、國泰永續高股息(00878) 1.60萬張、群益臺灣加權正2(00685L) 1.51萬張、元大台灣50(0050) 1.29萬張等。
外資賣超較多的電子股包括面板雙虎群創1.69萬張、友達1.48萬張，封測廠頎邦1.58萬張、京元電子4,994張、日月光投控3,581張，以及力積電1.62萬張、強茂1.46萬張；PCB的臻鼎-KY 7,534張、台虹3,816張、晶豪科5,052張等。
非電族群方面，外資賣超臺企銀1.94萬張居冠，另有彰銀6,872張，另有多檔傳產指標南亞5,625張、台泥5,210張、大成鋼4,372張、中石化3,874張等，ETF賣超群益ESG投等債20+(00937B) 1.04萬張較多。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks rose 693 points today (the 4th), with foreign investors switching from two consecutive days of net selling to a net purchase of NT$56.2 billion. However, net short positions on the Taiwan Index futures increased by 880 contracts to 82,300 contracts, showing a divergence between futures and spot markets. In terms of individual stocks, foreigners heavily bought the electronics OEM sector and made a large purchase of Yageo (stock code *102) worth over NT$10 billion, while adjusting positions in the panel‑maker twins and the test‑service group.

Foreign investors today bought heavily in the electronics OEM group: Compal (69,400 contracts), Foxconn (26,400 contracts), Wistron (23,900 contracts), Inventec (13,400 contracts), Quanta (12,800 contracts), UMC (26,600 contracts), Yageo (18,500 contracts), Acer (14,300 contracts) and Dingtian (11,200 contracts). In the financial sector, they favored First Financial (14,300 contracts) and Mega Financial (13,000 contracts).

In ETFs, the biggest net buys by foreigners were the active Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A) with 34,000 contracts, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L) with 18,800 contracts, Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878) with 16,000 contracts, Quanneng Taiwan Weighted Positive 2 (00685L) with 15,100 contracts, and Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050) with 12,900 contracts.

The electronics stocks with the largest foreign net sells included the panel‑maker twins: Innolux (16,900 contracts) and AU Optronics (14,800 contracts); test‑service firms: Qisda (15,800 contracts), Jing Yuan Electronics (4,994 contracts), and ASE Technology Holding (3,581 contracts); as well as Powerchip (16,200 contracts) and Protek (14,600 contracts). PCB makers also saw net selling: Zhen Ding‑KY (7,534 contracts), Tai Hong (3,816 contracts) and ChipMOS (5,052 contracts).

Outside the electronics sector, foreign investors net sold Taiwan Business Bank the most with 19,400 contracts, followed by Chang Hwa Bank (6,872 contracts). Other heavily sold traditional‑industry stocks included Nan Ya Plastics (5,625 contracts), Taiwan Cement (5,210 contracts), Da Cheng Steel (4,372 contracts) and Sinopec (3,874 contracts). Among ETFs, the biggest net sell was the Quanneng ESG Bond 20+ (00937B) with 10,400 contracts.

items.title: 伺服器PCB龍頭金像電砸138億中壢擴廠 投資台灣3方案累計衝2.8兆
items.title_en: Server PCB Leader Kinco Electronics Invests NT$13.8 Billion in Zhongli Expansion; Taiwan’s Three Investment Schemes Cumulative Total NT$2.8 Trillion
paras: 經濟部投資台灣事務所今(4)日通過兩家企業擴大投資台灣，分別為台商回台方案的伺服器PCB龍頭金像電子 (2368-TW)，以及中小企業方案的大舜鈑金，合計總投資金額高達140.7億元。其中，金像電單一投資即砸下138億元，展現深耕台灣與搶攻全球高階PCB市場的強烈企圖心。
金像電深耕台灣印刷電路板領域逾40年，逐步發展為跨國生產及全球銷售之專業PCB製造商，並在AI伺服器及高階網通PCB市場具備全球領先地位。為持續掌握市場趨勢並增加供貨彈性，金像電規劃於中壢產業園區興建新廠，建立全新多層PCB生產線，運用AI數據分析平台與自動化物流系統，全面提升生產與配送效率。
同時，金像電亦規劃減碳執行策略，導入碳足跡計畫及永續供應鏈管理計畫等，持續改善能源使用效率並優化產品減碳決策。本次總投資金額約138億元，預計新增900名本國員工，有助於提升高附加價值產品產能，強化智慧製造與供應鏈韌性，進一步帶動台灣PCB產業升級發展。
另一方面，大舜鈑金專門從事精密鈑金設計與製造業務，提供鈑金設計加工、腔體加工、精密框架製造、雷射切割、折床成型、焊接組裝、表面處理等客製化服務，產品廣泛應用於半導體、面板、工具機、航太等高科技產業。
繼109年申請中小企業加速投資行動方案後，大舜鈑金為持續發展核心技術與精進垂直整合製程能力，再度規劃擴大投資，擬於台南安平總廠等4座廠區內建置智慧化產線，導入新型智能機械手臂、AI工程圖分析及資料管理系統，同時進行溫室氣體盤查、建置太陽能發電設施等，積極落實節能減碳目標。本次總投資金額約2.7億元，將增聘8名本國員工，協助公司加速技術創新，鞏固長期競爭優勢並拓展國際市場布局。
截至目前，投資台灣三大方案已吸引1813家企業、約2兆7854億元投資，預估創造16萬9779個本國就業機會。其中，歡迎台商回台投資行動方案已有364家企業投資約1兆5168億元，帶來9萬6779個就業機會；中小企業加速投資行動方案則已吸引1215家企業投資約6240億元，可新增4萬2570個就業機會，後續尚有16家廠商排隊待審。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Investment Taiwan Office approved today the expansion of two companies in Taiwan: server‑PCB leader Kinco Electronics (2368‑TW) under the Taiwanese‑return scheme, and Da Shun Sheet Metal under the SME scheme, with a combined investment of NT$14.07 billion. Kinco alone is committing NT$13.8 billion, demonstrating a strong ambition to deepen its presence in Taiwan and capture the global high‑end PCB market.

Kinco has been rooted in Taiwan’s printed‑circuit‑board sector for more than 40 years, evolving into a multinational manufacturer and global seller that now holds a leading position in AI server and high‑end networking PCB markets. To stay ahead of market trends and increase supply flexibility, Kinco plans to build a new plant in the Zhongli industrial park, establishing a brand‑new multilayer PCB production line that will leverage an AI data‑analytics platform and automated logistics system to boost manufacturing and distribution efficiency.

Kinco also intends to implement carbon‑reduction strategies, introducing a carbon‑footprint program and sustainable supply‑chain management to continuously improve energy‑use efficiency and optimise product‑level carbon decisions. The total investment of about NT$13.8 billion is expected to create 900 domestic jobs, raise capacity for high‑value‑added products, strengthen smart manufacturing and supply‑chain resilience, and further drive the upgrade of Taiwan’s PCB industry.

Da Shun Sheet Metal specializes in precision sheet‑metal design and manufacturing, offering services such as sheet‑metal design processing, cavity machining, precision frame fabrication, laser cutting, press‑forming, welding assembly, and surface treatment. Its products are widely used in high‑tech sectors including semiconductors, display panels, machine tools and aerospace.

Following its 2020 application for the SME accelerated investment action plan, Da Shun is again planning a larger investment to develop core technologies and enhance vertical‑integration capabilities. It intends to install smart production lines in its Anping main plant in Tainan and three other sites, introducing new intelligent robotic arms, AI engineering‑drawing analysis and data‑management systems, while conducting greenhouse‑gas inventories and installing solar‑power facilities to meet energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction goals. The total investment is about NT$270 million, which will add eight domestic employees, helping the company accelerate technological innovation, solidify long‑term competitive advantage and expand its international market footprint.

To date, Taiwan’s three investment schemes have attracted 1,813 companies, roughly NT$2.7854 trillion in investment, and are projected to create 169,779 domestic jobs. The Taiwanese‑return scheme has drawn 364 companies investing about NT$1.5168 trillion, generating 96,779 jobs; the SME accelerated scheme has attracted 1,215 companies with about NT$624 billion in investment, adding 42,570 jobs, with 16 firms still awaiting approval.

items.title: 「末日博士」魯比尼不擔心債券拋售潮：殖利率主要是因AI榮景推升
items.title_en: ‘Doomsday Doctor’ Roubini Unconcerned About Bond Sell‑off: Yields Driven Mainly by AI Boom
paras: 曾在2008年全球金融海嘯期間因精準預言災難而聞名的經濟學家魯比尼(Nouriel Roubini)，周五(4日)接受彭博電視台訪問，對近期債券市場的劇烈波動發表了相當樂觀的看法。
魯比尼指出，近期長天期債券殖利率上升的最大驅動力，主要是由於對人工智慧繁榮和強勁的私人信貸需求的樂觀情緒，而不是更廣泛的經濟危機。
相較於過去的悲觀論調，魯比尼近年展現出較為溫和與晴朗的態度。他解釋，債券殖利率上升往往是經濟強勁成長的信號。當市場進入「冒險模式(risk-on)」、經濟成長力道強勁時，通常會伴隨股市上漲以及債券殖利率走高。
儘管美國公共債務規模在近期首度突破40兆美元，且債券殖利率攀升至2008年以來的最高點，魯比尼並不否認財政隱憂，但他強調，全球經濟已走出「大停滯」與近乎通貨緊縮的陷阱。
魯比尼表示，目前全球債券殖利率處於高位，是因為全球通膨率不再是零，而是維持在接近2%的合理運作區間，這意味著各國經濟已迎來投資與成長的新時代。
儘管他坦承市場仍面臨多重下行風險，包括荷姆茲海峽的局部封鎖、中東衝突升溫的隱憂、各國財政整頓可能衝擊國內需求，以及可能存在的AI泡沫化，但他認為這些多為常見的干擾因素，部分修正無可避免。
魯比尼強調，全球正處於實質性的全球投資榮景中，這將顯著提升生產力並帶動經濟成長。因此，他對整體的經濟前景抱持著相當樂觀的態度。
paras_en: Economist Nouriel Roubini, who became famous during the 2008 global financial crisis for accurately predicting the disaster, told Bloomberg Television on Friday (the 4th) that he is quite optimistic about the recent extreme volatility in the bond market.

Roubini said the biggest driver behind the recent rise in long‑term bond yields is optimism about a flourishing artificial‑intelligence sector and strong private‑credit demand, not a broader economic crisis.

Compared with past pessimistic narratives, Roubini has shown a milder and brighter outlook in recent years. He explained that rising bond yields often signal robust economic growth; when markets shift into a ‘risk‑on’ mode and growth is strong, equities usually rise together with bond yields.

Even though U.S. public debt has just broken the $40 trillion mark for the first time and yields have climbed to their highest level since 2008, Roubini does not deny fiscal concerns but stresses that the global economy has emerged from a ‘great stagnation’ and near‑deflationary trap.

Roubini said current global bond yields are high because global inflation is no longer zero but hovering around a reasonable 2% range, indicating that economies worldwide have entered a new era of investment and growth.

He acknowledged that markets still face multiple downside risks—including a localized closure of the Hormuz Strait, escalating Middle‑East tensions, fiscal tightening that could curb domestic demand, and a possible AI bubble—but he views these as typical disruptions, some correction of which is inevitable.

Roubini emphasized that the world is in a genuine global investment boom that will markedly boost productivity and drive economic growth, so he remains considerably optimistic about the overall economic outlook.

items.title: 川普想救晶片供應鏈卻害慘美國工廠？600人飯碗恐不保
items.title_en: Trump Aims to Rescue Chip Supply Chain but May Harm U.S. Factories? About 600 Jobs at Risk
paras: 美國川普政府為強化本土半導體供應鏈祭出的新貿易措施，恐怕適得其反。《路透》周五(4日)援引知情人士消息報導，德國化工大廠瓦克化學(Wacker Chemie)位於田納西州查爾斯頓的多晶矽工廠，在政策公布後流失僅存的兩家客戶，目前正面臨關閉風險，約600名員工的生計也可能受到波及。
據了解，瓦克化學預計未來幾周內決定是否關閉這座工廠，但《路透》目前無法確認兩家客戶的身分。瓦克化學也未就客戶流失或潛在關廠計畫置評。這座工廠原本是華府希望保護的關鍵設施之一，如今卻可能成為川普政府貿易政策下的受害者。
這也成為川普貿易政策未能有效扶植目標產業的最新案例。先前美國對鋼鐵與鋁材加徵關稅，一度推高美國汽車製造商的成本並削弱其對抗進口車的能力，直到政府採取額外措施後才有所緩解。
政策未獎勵美國原料 反讓客戶轉身離開
白宮上月發布公告，希望藉由貿易措施鼓勵業者採購美國製多晶矽。相關措施於8月6日公布，將自12月起生效，包括對進口多晶矽錠、晶圓、太陽能電池與面板設定最低價格及加徵關稅。
問題在於，現行規則對海外製造的產品一體適用，不論使用的是美國或中國多晶矽，待遇都沒有差別，並未給予美國原料額外優惠。根據市場研究機構Bernreuter Research資料，美國多晶矽價格最高可達外國產品的4倍，現行制度等於讓本土產品的成本劣勢繼續存在，也難以鼓勵客戶改用美國原料。
瓦克化學表示，目前評估政策對公司業務的影響仍言之過早，但直言依照現行條文，相關措施「無法有效支持使用美國製多晶矽」。公司正與川普政府積極協商，希望找出真正能達成保護本土生產商目標的做法。
Wood Mackenzie分析師皮爾斯(Elissa Pierce)也指出，依照目前設計，市場並不預期《貿易擴張法》第232條關稅能夠帶動美國多晶矽需求。反而是與中國存在關聯、總部位於阿曼的海外競爭對手United Solar Polysilicon，對這項措施表示歡迎。
抗中政策恐適得其反 600人工作面臨威脅
這起事件也令人質疑，川普政府能否真正保護美國半導體供應鏈，避免中國擴大主導地位。中國企業長期稱霸太陽能級多晶矽市場，近年更逐步進軍純度要求更高的半導體級多晶矽領域。
主張關稅及產業政策的美國繁榮聯盟(Coalition for a Prosperous America)指出，美國目前僅有兩家公司生產多晶矽，政府制定執行規則時，應明確獎勵採購美國產品。
該組織發言人艾科維拉(Nick Iacovella)警告，若政府不能明確釋出訊號，確立本土多晶矽是太陽能與半導體供應鏈的基礎，美國恐將這兩個產業拱手讓給外國競爭對手及中國等敵對國家，構成直接的國家安全威脅。
美國商務部未回應置評要求。川普政府官員則表示，政府仍持續與產業利害關係人溝通，以完善多晶矽製造回流美國的策略。公告也授權商務部向投資美國多晶矽產能的企業提供獎勵，但相關條件必須與個別企業逐案協商。
除了瓦克化學，Hemlock Semiconductor是美國僅存的另一家多晶矽製造商，但受到新措施的衝擊相對有限。Hemlock母公司康寧(GLW-US)會採購其生產的太陽能級多晶矽，並在美國國內進一步製成晶圓，因此較不依賴其他客戶需求。
瓦克化學在美國與德國的業務近年均飽受中國競爭衝擊，去年已在耗資25億美元興建的查爾斯頓工廠裁員。執行長哈特爾(Christian Hartel)在政策公布前數日便曾向投資人警告，若期待中的貿易措施無法帶來實質助益，公司可能「多了一座工廠」。
paras_en: The Trump administration's new trade measures to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain may backfire, Reuters reported on Friday (the 4th) that Wacker Chemie’s polysilicon plant in Charleston, Tennessee is losing its last two customers after the policy announcement and now faces closure, putting roughly 600 employees' livelihoods at risk.

Wacker Chemie expects to decide within the next few weeks whether to shut the plant, but Reuters could not confirm the identities of the two customers. The company did not comment on the customer loss or any potential shutdown plan. The plant was originally one of the key facilities Washington hoped to protect, yet it may become a victim of the Trump administration’s trade policy.

This adds to the growing list of examples where Trump’s trade policies have failed to effectively support target industries. Earlier U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum once drove up costs for American automakers and weakened their ability to compete with imported cars, only easing after the government took additional steps.
The policy does not reward U.S. raw materials, instead prompting customers to walk away

Last month the White House announced a trade measure intended to encourage companies to buy U.S.-made polysilicon. The measures, unveiled on August 6, will take effect in December and include minimum price floors and tariffs on imported polysilicon ingots, wafers, solar cells and panels.

The problem is that the current rules apply uniformly to overseas‑made products, regardless of whether they contain U.S. or Chinese polysilicon, offering no extra advantage to U.S. material. According to market‑research firm Bernreuter Research, U.S. polysilicon can cost up to four times as much as foreign products, so the existing regime leaves a cost disadvantage for domestic producers and does little to persuade customers to switch to U.S. material.

Wacker Chemie said it is still too early to assess the policy’s impact on its business, but bluntly noted that under the current wording the measures “cannot effectively support the use of U.S.-made polysilicon.” The company is actively negotiating with the Trump administration to find a truly protective approach for domestic manufacturers.

Wood Mackenzie analyst Elissa Pierce also pointed out that, as designed, the market does not expect the Section 232 tariff under the Trade Expansion Act to boost U.S. polysilicon demand. Instead, overseas competitor United Solar Polysilicon, which is linked to China and headquartered in Oman, welcomed the measure.
Anti‑China policies may backfire, threatening 600 jobs

The episode raises doubts about whether the Trump administration can truly safeguard the U.S. semiconductor supply chain and keep China from expanding its dominance. Chinese firms have long dominated the solar‑grade polysilicon market and have recently moved into the higher‑purity, semiconductor‑grade segment.

The Coalition for a Prosperous America, which advocates tariffs and industrial policy, notes that only two companies in the United States produce polysilicon and that the government’s implementation rules should explicitly reward purchases of U.S. products.

Coalition spokesperson Nick Iacovella warned that if the government does not send a clear signal that domestic polysilicon is the foundation of the solar and semiconductor supply chains, the U.S. could hand both industries over to foreign competitors and hostile nations like China, creating a direct national‑security threat.

The U.S. Commerce Department did not respond to requests for comment. Trump officials said the government continues to engage with industry stakeholders to refine a strategy for bringing polysilicon manufacturing back to the United States. The announcement also authorizes the Commerce Department to offer incentives to firms that invest in U.S. polysilicon capacity, though the terms must be negotiated case‑by‑case with each company.

Besides Wacker Chemie, Hemlock Semiconductor is the only other U.S. polysilicon producer, but it is less affected by the new measures. Hemlock’s parent Corning (GLW‑US) purchases its solar‑grade polysilicon and further processes it into wafers domestically, making it less dependent on external customer demand.

Wacker Chemie’s U.S. and German operations have both been hit hard by Chinese competition in recent years. Last year the company cut staff at the $2.5 billion Charleston plant it built. CEO Christian Hartel warned investors days before the policy rollout that if the expected trade measures fail to deliver real benefits, the company could end up with “one more factory.”

items.title: 營收速報  - 華邦電(2344)8月營收273.09億元年增率高達289.43％
items.title_en: Revenue Flash - Winbond Electronics (2344) August revenue NT$27.309 billion, year‑over‑year growth 289.43%

items.title: 全訊8月營收年月雙增 受惠軍工出貨、認列國防標案雙引擎推進
items.title_en: FullSignal Reports Dual Growth in August Revenue Year-over-Year and Month-over-Month, Driven by Military Shipments and Defense Contract Recognition
paras: 砷化鎵、功率放大器(PA)製造商全訊(5222-TW)今(4)日公告8月營收為6,951萬元、月增5.61％、年增59.94％，累計今(2026)年前8月合併營收為5.41億元、年減10.15％。全訊表示，8月營收年月雙增，主要受惠國內外軍工產品出貨與認列進度同步推進，目前公司在國防標案、海外軍工、及無人機干擾系統等多項產品線均維持正常量產節奏下，海外客戶需求也持續成長，整體營運保持穩健動能。
對近日國內報載，國防部已送交立法院在明(2027)年度的國防預算報告書中，也已將中層反戰術彈道飛彈系統，改列為年度的常態公務預算編列，來構築台灣的區域防空與多層次攔截火網。全訊也表示，身為國內極少數具備飛彈用 SSPA 量產經驗及軍品認證的廠商，有望持續受惠此一商機，貢獻公司獲利。
此外，全訊隨著新年度預算明確、需求規劃逐步落地，國防飛彈專用SSPA相關產品，明年可望重啟量產，由於攔截與防禦飛彈用SSPA 的技術門檻高、供應商更替不易，具備長期合作特性，為公司未來營運增添穩健的成長動能。
在軍用無人機反制系統方面，全訊也自主研發生產的固態高功率放大器系列產品，主要規格為 6GHz以下頻段及輸出功率5W、10W、50W、100W，目前已獲海外軍工客戶採用，應用涵蓋邊境防務、基地防護與重要設施安全，國內客戶近期亦積極洽談，後續可望陸續進入驗證與採購流程。
展望未來， 全訊持審慎樂觀態度，主要在於軍工產品出貨穩健、國防飛彈SSPA明年可望重啟量產、無人機干擾系統生產擴大，三大產品線形成多軸並進的成長結構，加上高頻射頻、氮化鎵製程與SSPA技術布局持續深化，均可望挹注公司營運發展。
paras_en: FullSignal (5222-TW), a gallium arsenide and power amplifier (PA) manufacturer, announced today that August revenue was NT$69.51 million, up 5.61% month‑over‑month and 59.94% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of 2026 was NT$541 million, a 10.15% decline year‑over‑year. The company said the double‑digit growth in August was mainly thanks to shipments of domestic and overseas military products and the synchronized progress of defense‑contract recognitions. With normal production rhythms across defense contracts, overseas military projects and UAV‑jamming systems, overseas customer demand continues to rise and overall operations remain robust.

Regarding recent domestic reports that the Ministry of National Defense has submitted to the Legislative Yuan the 2027 defense budget, the mid‑range anti‑tactical ballistic missile system has been re‑classified as a regular annual budget item to build Taiwan’s regional air‑defense and multi‑layered interception network. FullSignal noted that, as one of the few domestic firms with mass‑production experience and military certification for missile‑grade SSPA, it is well positioned to benefit from this opportunity and contribute to profitability.

Furthermore, with the new fiscal year budget clarified and demand plans taking shape, defense‑missile‑specific SSPA products are expected to resume mass production next year. Because the technical barriers for interceptor and defense‑missile SSPA are high and supplier changes are difficult, the long‑term partnership nature adds a steady growth engine to the company’s future operations.

In the military UAV counter‑measure segment, FullSignal has independently developed and produced a solid‑state high‑power amplifier series targeting frequencies below 6 GHz with output powers of 5 W, 10 W, 50 W and 100 W. These products have already been adopted by overseas defense customers for border security, base protection and critical‑facility safety, and domestic customers are actively negotiating, with verification and procurement processes expected to follow soon.

Looking ahead, FullSignal maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook, driven by stable military product shipments, the anticipated restart of missile‑grade SSPA mass production next year, and expanded UAV‑jamming system manufacturing. The three product lines form a multi‑axis growth structure, while deeper investments in high‑frequency RF, GaN processes and SSPA technology are expected to further fuel the company’s operational development.

items.title: 鴻海子公司Foxconn Singapore公司債定價完成 發行總金額1019億日圓
items.title_en: Foxconn Subsidiary Foxconn Singapore Completes Bond Pricing, Total Issuance 101.9 Billion Yen
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(4)日公告，子公司Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd為募集資金，擬以鴻海提供擔保之中期債券發行平台(MTN)發行總額合計1,019億日元(約新台幣206.56億元 )之普通公司債。
鴻海表示，其中657億日元之公司債，期間為3年到期，發行利率為2.92%；362億日元之公司債，期間為5年到期，發行利率為3.28%。
根據鴻海財報資料，Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd為鴻海100%持股的控股公司，Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd及其所屬子公司為從事亞洲地區銷售業務之據點，其轉投資事業係從事教育科技之開發。
隨AI業務成長、全球製造布局擴大及自動化需求增加，鴻海資本支出規模持續提高，今年上半年約809億元，年增37億元，全年預期將較去年1738億元成長3成以上，主要投入AI伺服器機櫃、液冷、測試等關鍵產能，以及全球製造與自動化布局。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today that its subsidiary Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd plans to raise funds by issuing ordinary corporate bonds with a total amount of 101.9 billion yen (approximately NT$20.656 billion) on a medium‑term note (MTN) platform guaranteed by Foxconn.
Of the total, 65.7 billion yen of bonds have a three‑year term with an issuance rate of 2.92%, while 36.2 billion yen of bonds have a five‑year term with an issuance rate of 3.28%.

According to Foxconn’s financial statements, Foxconn Singapore Pte Ltd is a wholly‑owned subsidiary of Foxconn. Foxconn Singapore and its subsidiaries serve as sales hubs for the Asian region, and its investment business focuses on the development of educational technology.

With AI business growth, expansion of global manufacturing footprints, and rising automation demand, Foxconn’s capital expenditures continue to rise, reaching about NT$80.9 billion in the first half of this year, up NT$3.7 billion year‑over‑year, and are expected to exceed NT$173.8 billion for the full year—more than a 30% increase over last year—primarily directed toward AI server racks, liquid cooling, testing and other key capacities, as well as global manufacturing and automation initiatives.

items.title: 川習會有戲了？傳習近平罕見帶企業高層赴美談生意
paras: 中國國家主席習近平正準備於本月訪問華府時，率領一支大型企業代表團同行。知情人士表示，在美國對中國投資抱持高度疑慮、北京與民營企業關係仍顯緊張之際，這項安排並不尋常，可能意在向美方釋出支持投資及商業往來的訊號。
《路透》周五(4日)獨家報導，習近平預定9月24日與美國總統川普舉行峰會，隨行企業代表團的安排先前並未曝光，目前尚無法確認哪些中國企業高層將會參加。
一名了解討論內容的消息人士表示，中方希望藉此表明推動美中投資與商業關係的意願，同時在美國期中選舉前，為白宮提供一些可以對外宣傳的經濟成果。

罕見率大型企業團訪美 上次已是2015年

習近平鮮少帶著企業高層出訪，尤其北京自2020年起對科技、教育及房地產等產業展開監管整頓後，不少民營企業家一度失去官方青睞。
他上一次率領大規模企業代表團訪美是在2015年，成員包括阿里巴巴(09988-HK)(BABA-US)創辦人馬雲、騰訊(00700-HK)創辦人馬化騰，以及中國銀行與國營企業高層。
訪問期間，中國簽署採購300架波音(BA-US)飛機、總值380億美元的協議；習近平也與蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)、Meta(META-US)執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)等美國科技界領袖會面。
相較之下，川普過去訪中時經常率領大型美國企業代表團，包括2017年及今年5月的行程。今年5月隨行的18名美國企業高層，包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳及特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克。
華府智庫戰略暨國際研究中心(CSIS)中國商業專家甘思德(Scott Kennedy)表示，中方這次似乎將更有意識地安排企業高層參與代表團，這些人的加入可能相當有價值。他並認為，美方5月的企業代表團籌組倉促，企業高層與其說是重要參與者，更像是站在一旁陪襯。

峰會突破預期有限 聚焦貿易機制與稀土出口

儘管中方安排大型企業代表團，但消息人士對峰會成果仍持審慎態度。美中5月宣布建立管理雙邊貿易與投資關係的正式機制，不過由於美國對中國投資的環境仍充滿挑戰，投資委員會不太可能在峰會期間提出重大成果。
雙方對貿易委員會可納入哪些「非敏感」產品仍有分歧，目前正在討論約10類商品，但最終範圍可能在峰會前調整。美方此次峰會的主要目標之一，是就貿易委員會達成協議，並替美國企業爭取更多中國稀土出口許可。
美國官員表示，川普政府仍持續要求中國履行雙方去年10月於釜山達成的協議。該協議促成為期一年的貿易休戰，暫停部分出口管制與關稅措施。北京則要求美方進一步降低關稅，中國商務部7月透露，雙方正研究針對價值300億美元商品相互調降關稅。
美國最高法院2月推翻依《國際緊急經濟權力法》對中國加徵的關稅後，華府隨後推出10%的全球進口關稅。美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)周四透露，兩國將在峰會期間就農業及非關稅壁壘發布若干消息，但未說明細節。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)、葛里爾與中國國務院副總理何立峰預計9月初會面，討論峰會可能取得的成果，確切時間與地點目前尚未確定。

非電族群方面，外資賣超臺企銀1.94萬張居冠，另有彰銀6,872張，另有多檔傳產指標南亞5,625張、台泥5,210張、大成鋼4,372張、中石化3,874張等，ETF賣超群益ESG投等債20+(00937B) 1.04萬張較多。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks rose 693 points today (the 4th), with foreign investors switching from two consecutive days of net selling to a net purchase of NT$56.2 billion. However, net short positions on the Taiwan Index futures increased by 880 contracts to 82,300 contracts, showing a divergence between futures and spot markets. In terms of individual stocks, foreigners heavily bought the electronics OEM sector and made a large purchase of Yageo (stock code *102) worth over NT$10 billion, while adjusting positions in the panel‑maker twins and the test‑service group.

Foreign investors today bought heavily in the electronics OEM group: Compal (69,400 contracts), Foxconn (26,400 contracts), Wistron (23,900 contracts), Inventec (13,400 contracts), Quanta (12,800 contracts), UMC (26,600 contracts), Yageo (18,500 contracts), Acer (14,300 contracts) and Dingtian (11,200 contracts). In the financial sector, they favored First Financial (14,300 contracts) and Mega Financial (13,000 contracts).

In ETFs, the biggest net buys by foreigners were the active Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A) with 34,000 contracts, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L) with 18,800 contracts, Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878) with 16,000 contracts, Quanneng Taiwan Weighted Positive 2 (00685L) with 15,100 contracts, and Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050) with 12,900 contracts.

The electronics stocks with the largest foreign net sells included the panel‑maker twins: Innolux (16,900 contracts) and AU Optronics (14,800 contracts); test‑service firms: Qisda (15,800 contracts), Jing Yuan Electronics (4,994 contracts), and ASE Technology Holding (3,581 contracts); as well as Powerchip (16,200 contracts) and Protek (14,600 contracts). PCB makers also saw net selling: Zhen Ding‑KY (7,534 contracts), Tai Hong (3,816 contracts) and ChipMOS (5,052 contracts).

Outside the electronics sector, foreign investors net sold Taiwan Business Bank the most with 19,400 contracts, followed by Chang Hwa Bank (6,872 contracts). Other heavily sold traditional‑industry stocks included Nan Ya Plastics (5,625 contracts), Taiwan Cement (5,210 contracts), Da Cheng Steel (4,372 contracts) and Sinopec (3,874 contracts). Among ETFs, the biggest net sell was the Quanneng ESG Bond 20+ (00937B) with 10,400 contracts.

items.title: 伺服器PCB龍頭金像電砸138億中壢擴廠 投資台灣3方案累計衝2.8兆
items.title_en: Server PCB Leader Kinco Electronics Invests NT$13.8 Billion in Zhongli Expansion; Taiwan’s Three Investment Schemes Cumulative Total NT$2.8 Trillion
paras: 經濟部投資台灣事務所今(4)日通過兩家企業擴大投資台灣，分別為台商回台方案的伺服器PCB龍頭金像電子 (2368-TW)，以及中小企業方案的大舜鈑金，合計總投資金額高達140.7億元。其中，金像電單一投資即砸下138億元，展現深耕台灣與搶攻全球高階PCB市場的強烈企圖心。
金像電深耕台灣印刷電路板領域逾40年，逐步發展為跨國生產及全球銷售之專業PCB製造商，並在AI伺服器及高階網通PCB市場具備全球領先地位。為持續掌握市場趨勢並增加供貨彈性，金像電規劃於中壢產業園區興建新廠，建立全新多層PCB生產線，運用AI數據分析平台與自動化物流系統，全面提升生產與配送效率。
同時，金像電亦規劃減碳執行策略，導入碳足跡計畫及永續供應鏈管理計畫等，持續改善能源使用效率並優化產品減碳決策。本次總投資金額約138億元，預計新增900名本國員工，有助於提升高附加價值產品產能，強化智慧製造與供應鏈韌性，進一步帶動台灣PCB產業升級發展。
另一方面，大舜鈑金專門從事精密鈑金設計與製造業務，提供鈑金設計加工、腔體加工、精密框架製造、雷射切割、折床成型、焊接組裝、表面處理等客製化服務，產品廣泛應用於半導體、面板、工具機、航太等高科技產業。
繼109年申請中小企業加速投資行動方案後，大舜鈑金為持續發展核心技術與精進垂直整合製程能力，再度規劃擴大投資，擬於台南安平總廠等4座廠區內建置智慧化產線，導入新型智能機械手臂、AI工程圖分析及資料管理系統，同時進行溫室氣體盤查、建置太陽能發電設施等，積極落實節能減碳目標。本次總投資金額約2.7億元，將增聘8名本國員工，協助公司加速技術創新，鞏固長期競爭優勢並拓展國際市場布局。
截至目前，投資台灣三大方案已吸引1813家企業、約2兆7854億元投資，預估創造16萬9779個本國就業機會。其中，歡迎台商回台投資行動方案已有364家企業投資約1兆5168億元，帶來9萬6779個就業機會；中小企業加速投資行動方案則已吸引1215家企業投資約6240億元，可新增4萬2570個就業機會，後續尚有16家廠商排隊待審。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Investment Taiwan Office approved today the expansion of two companies in Taiwan: server‑PCB leader Kinco Electronics (2368‑TW) under the Taiwanese‑return scheme, and Da Shun Sheet Metal under the SME scheme, with a combined investment of NT$14.07 billion. Kinco alone is committing NT$13.8 billion, demonstrating a strong ambition to deepen its presence in Taiwan and capture the global high‑end PCB market.

Kinco has been rooted in Taiwan’s printed‑circuit‑board sector for more than 40 years, evolving into a multinational manufacturer and global seller that now holds a leading position in AI server and high‑end networking PCB markets. To stay ahead of market trends and increase supply flexibility, Kinco plans to build a new plant in the Zhongli industrial park, establishing a brand‑new multilayer PCB production line that will leverage an AI data‑analytics platform and automated logistics system to boost manufacturing and distribution efficiency.

Kinco also intends to implement carbon‑reduction strategies, introducing a carbon‑footprint program and sustainable supply‑chain management to continuously improve energy‑use efficiency and optimise product‑level carbon decisions. The total investment of about NT$13.8 billion is expected to create 900 domestic jobs, raise capacity for high‑value‑added products, strengthen smart manufacturing and supply‑chain resilience, and further drive the upgrade of Taiwan’s PCB industry.

Da Shun Sheet Metal specializes in precision sheet‑metal design and manufacturing, offering services such as sheet‑metal design processing, cavity machining, precision frame fabrication, laser cutting, press‑forming, welding assembly, and surface treatment. Its products are widely used in high‑tech sectors including semiconductors, display panels, machine tools and aerospace.

Following its 2020 application for the SME accelerated investment action plan, Da Shun is again planning a larger investment to develop core technologies and enhance vertical‑integration capabilities. It intends to install smart production lines in its Anping main plant in Tainan and three other sites, introducing new intelligent robotic arms, AI engineering‑drawing analysis and data‑management systems, while conducting greenhouse‑gas inventories and installing solar‑power facilities to meet energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction goals. The total investment is about NT$270 million, which will add eight domestic employees, helping the company accelerate technological innovation, solidify long‑term competitive advantage and expand its international market footprint.

To date, Taiwan’s three investment schemes have attracted 1,813 companies, roughly NT$2.7854 trillion in investment, and are projected to create 169,779 domestic jobs. The Taiwanese‑return scheme has drawn 364 companies investing about NT$1.5168 trillion, generating 96,779 jobs; the SME accelerated scheme has attracted 1,215 companies with about NT$624 billion in investment, adding 42,570 jobs, with 16 firms still awaiting approval.

items.title: 「末日博士」魯比尼不擔心債券拋售潮：殖利率主要是因AI榮景推升
items.title_en: ‘Doomsday Doctor’ Roubini Unconcerned About Bond Sell‑off: Yields Driven Mainly by AI Boom
paras: 曾在2008年全球金融海嘯期間因精準預言災難而聞名的經濟學家魯比尼(Nouriel Roubini)，周五(4日)接受彭博電視台訪問，對近期債券市場的劇烈波動發表了相當樂觀的看法。
魯比尼指出，近期長天期債券殖利率上升的最大驅動力，主要是由於對人工智慧繁榮和強勁的私人信貸需求的樂觀情緒，而不是更廣泛的經濟危機。
相較於過去的悲觀論調，魯比尼近年展現出較為溫和與晴朗的態度。他解釋，債券殖利率上升往往是經濟強勁成長的信號。當市場進入「冒險模式(risk-on)」、經濟成長力道強勁時，通常會伴隨股市上漲以及債券殖利率走高。
儘管美國公共債務規模在近期首度突破40兆美元，且債券殖利率攀升至2008年以來的最高點，魯比尼並不否認財政隱憂，但他強調，全球經濟已走出「大停滯」與近乎通貨緊縮的陷阱。
魯比尼表示，目前全球債券殖利率處於高位，是因為全球通膨率不再是零，而是維持在接近2%的合理運作區間，這意味著各國經濟已迎來投資與成長的新時代。
儘管他坦承市場仍面臨多重下行風險，包括荷姆茲海峽的局部封鎖、中東衝突升溫的隱憂、各國財政整頓可能衝擊國內需求，以及可能存在的AI泡沫化，但他認為這些多為常見的干擾因素，部分修正無可避免。
魯比尼強調，全球正處於實質性的全球投資榮景中，這將顯著提升生產力並帶動經濟成長。因此，他對整體的經濟前景抱持著相當樂觀的態度。
paras_en: Economist Nouriel Roubini, who became famous during the 2008 global financial crisis for accurately predicting the disaster, told Bloomberg Television on Friday (the 4th) that he is quite optimistic about the recent extreme volatility in the bond market.

Roubini said the biggest driver behind the recent rise in long‑term bond yields is optimism about a flourishing artificial‑intelligence sector and strong private‑credit demand, not a broader economic crisis.

Compared with past pessimistic narratives, Roubini has shown a milder and brighter outlook in recent years. He explained that rising bond yields often signal robust economic growth; when markets shift into a ‘risk‑on’ mode and growth is strong, equities usually rise together with bond yields.

Even though U.S. public debt has just broken the $40 trillion mark for the first time and yields have climbed to their highest level since 2008, Roubini does not deny fiscal concerns but stresses that the global economy has emerged from a ‘great stagnation’ and near‑deflationary trap.

Roubini said current global bond yields are high because global inflation is no longer zero but hovering around a reasonable 2% range, indicating that economies worldwide have entered a new era of investment and growth.

He acknowledged that markets still face multiple downside risks—including a localized closure of the Hormuz Strait, escalating Middle‑East tensions, fiscal tightening that could curb domestic demand, and a possible AI bubble—but he views these as typical disruptions, some correction of which is inevitable.

Roubini emphasized that the world is in a genuine global investment boom that will markedly boost productivity and drive economic growth, so he remains considerably optimistic about the overall economic outlook.

items.title: 川普想救晶片供應鏈卻害慘美國工廠？600人飯碗恐不保
items.title_en: Trump Aims to Rescue Chip Supply Chain but May Harm U.S. Factories? About 600 Jobs at Risk
paras: 美國川普政府為強化本土半導體供應鏈祭出的新貿易措施，恐怕適得其反。《路透》周五(4日)援引知情人士消息報導，德國化工大廠瓦克化學(Wacker Chemie)位於田納西州查爾斯頓的多晶矽工廠，在政策公布後流失僅存的兩家客戶，目前正面臨關閉風險，約600名員工的生計也可能受到波及。
據了解，瓦克化學預計未來幾周內決定是否關閉這座工廠，但《路透》目前無法確認兩家客戶的身分。瓦克化學也未就客戶流失或潛在關廠計畫置評。這座工廠原本是華府希望保護的關鍵設施之一，如今卻可能成為川普政府貿易政策下的受害者。
這也成為川普貿易政策未能有效扶植目標產業的最新案例。先前美國對鋼鐵與鋁材加徵關稅，一度推高美國汽車製造商的成本並削弱其對抗進口車的能力，直到政府採取額外措施後才有所緩解。
政策未獎勵美國原料 反讓客戶轉身離開
白宮上月發布公告，希望藉由貿易措施鼓勵業者採購美國製多晶矽。相關措施於8月6日公布，將自12月起生效，包括對進口多晶矽錠、晶圓、太陽能電池與面板設定最低價格及加徵關稅。
問題在於，現行規則對海外製造的產品一體適用，不論使用的是美國或中國多晶矽，待遇都沒有差別，並未給予美國原料額外優惠。根據市場研究機構Bernreuter Research資料，美國多晶矽價格最高可達外國產品的4倍，現行制度等於讓本土產品的成本劣勢繼續存在，也難以鼓勵客戶改用美國原料。
瓦克化學表示，目前評估政策對公司業務的影響仍言之過早，但直言依照現行條文，相關措施「無法有效支持使用美國製多晶矽」。公司正與川普政府積極協商，希望找出真正能達成保護本土生產商目標的做法。
Wood Mackenzie分析師皮爾斯(Elissa Pierce)也指出，依照目前設計，市場並不預期《貿易擴張法》第232條關稅能夠帶動美國多晶矽需求。反而是與中國存在關聯、總部位於阿曼的海外競爭對手United Solar Polysilicon，對這項措施表示歡迎。
抗中政策恐適得其反 600人工作面臨威脅
這起事件也令人質疑，川普政府能否真正保護美國半導體供應鏈，避免中國擴大主導地位。中國企業長期稱霸太陽能級多晶矽市場，近年更逐步進軍純度要求更高的半導體級多晶矽領域。
主張關稅及產業政策的美國繁榮聯盟(Coalition for a Prosperous America)指出，美國目前僅有兩家公司生產多晶矽，政府制定執行規則時，應明確獎勵採購美國產品。
該組織發言人艾科維拉(Nick Iacovella)警告，若政府不能明確釋出訊號，確立本土多晶矽是太陽能與半導體供應鏈的基礎，美國恐將這兩個產業拱手讓給外國競爭對手及中國等敵對國家，構成直接的國家安全威脅。
美國商務部未回應置評要求。川普政府官員則表示，政府仍持續與產業利害關係人溝通，以完善多晶矽製造回流美國的策略。公告也授權商務部向投資美國多晶矽產能的企業提供獎勵，但相關條件必須與個別企業逐案協商。
除了瓦克化學，Hemlock Semiconductor是美國僅存的另一家多晶矽製造商，但受到新措施的衝擊相對有限。Hemlock母公司康寧(GLW-US)會採購其生產的太陽能級多晶矽，並在美國國內進一步製成晶圓，因此較不依賴其他客戶需求。
瓦克化學在美國與德國的業務近年均飽受中國競爭衝擊，去年已在耗資25億美元興建的查爾斯頓工廠裁員。執行長哈特爾(Christian Hartel)在政策公布前數日便曾向投資人警告，若期待中的貿易措施無法帶來實質助益，公司可能「多了一座工廠」。
paras_en: The Trump administration's new trade measures to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain may backfire, Reuters reported on Friday (the 4th) that Wacker Chemie’s polysilicon plant in Charleston, Tennessee is losing its last two customers after the policy announcement and now faces closure, putting roughly 600 employees' livelihoods at risk.

Wacker Chemie expects to decide within the next few weeks whether to shut the plant, but Reuters could not confirm the identities of the two customers. The company did not comment on the customer loss or any potential shutdown plan. The plant was originally one of the key facilities Washington hoped to protect, yet it may become a victim of the Trump administration’s trade policy.

This adds to the growing list of examples where Trump’s trade policies have failed to effectively support target industries. Earlier U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum once drove up costs for American automakers and weakened their ability to compete with imported cars, only easing after the government took additional steps.
The policy does not reward U.S. raw materials, instead prompting customers to walk away

Last month the White House announced a trade measure intended to encourage companies to buy U.S.-made polysilicon. The measures, unveiled on August 6, will take effect in December and include minimum price floors and tariffs on imported polysilicon ingots, wafers, solar cells and panels.

The problem is that the current rules apply uniformly to overseas‑made products, regardless of whether they contain U.S. or Chinese polysilicon, offering no extra advantage to U.S. material. According to market‑research firm Bernreuter Research, U.S. polysilicon can cost up to four times as much as foreign products, so the existing regime leaves a cost disadvantage for domestic producers and does little to persuade customers to switch to U.S. material.

Wacker Chemie said it is still too early to assess the policy’s impact on its business, but bluntly noted that under the current wording the measures “cannot effectively support the use of U.S.-made polysilicon.” The company is actively negotiating with the Trump administration to find a truly protective approach for domestic manufacturers.

Wood Mackenzie analyst Elissa Pierce also pointed out that, as designed, the market does not expect the Section 232 tariff under the Trade Expansion Act to boost U.S. polysilicon demand. Instead, overseas competitor United Solar Polysilicon, which is linked to China and headquartered in Oman, welcomed the measure.
Anti‑China policies may backfire, threatening 600 jobs

The episode raises doubts about whether the Trump administration can truly safeguard the U.S. semiconductor supply chain and keep China from expanding its dominance. Chinese firms have long dominated the solar‑grade polysilicon market and have recently moved into the higher‑purity, semiconductor‑grade segment.

The Coalition for a Prosperous America, which advocates tariffs and industrial policy, notes that only two companies in the United States produce polysilicon and that the government’s implementation rules should explicitly reward purchases of U.S. products.

Coalition spokesperson Nick Iacovella warned that if the government does not send a clear signal that domestic polysilicon is the foundation of the solar and semiconductor supply chains, the U.S. could hand both industries over to foreign competitors and hostile nations like China, creating a direct national‑security threat.

The U.S. Commerce Department did not respond to requests for comment. Trump officials said the government continues to engage with industry stakeholders to refine a strategy for bringing polysilicon manufacturing back to the United States. The announcement also authorizes the Commerce Department to offer incentives to firms that invest in U.S. polysilicon capacity, though the terms must be negotiated case‑by‑case with each company.

Besides Wacker Chemie, Hemlock Semiconductor is the only other U.S. polysilicon producer, but it is less affected by the new measures. Hemlock’s parent Corning (GLW‑US) purchases its solar‑grade polysilicon and further processes it into wafers domestically, making it less dependent on external customer demand.

Wacker Chemie’s U.S. and German operations have both been hit hard by Chinese competition in recent years. Last year the company cut staff at the $2.5 billion Charleston plant it built. CEO Christian Hartel warned investors days before the policy rollout that if the expected trade measures fail to deliver real benefits, the company could end up with “one more factory.”

items.title: 美光首輪勞資調解無共識 數周內將公布更多獎勵細節
items.title_en: Micron’s First Labor Mediation Session Ends Without Agreement; More Incentive Details to Be Released in Coming Weeks
paras: 美光(MU-US)於台灣的勞資爭議持續延燒。美光今(4)日與桃園工會進行正式調解，雙方首輪協商尚未達成共識，但已規畫召開第二次調解會議，延續實質對話。面對員工要求改革獎金及盈餘分享制度，美光也進一步釋出善意，除重申將以具競爭力薪酬、績效獎勵回饋員工，更預告未來幾周內將公布更多獎勵細節，市場關注能否進一步化解潛在罷工危機。
美光近期在台爆發勞資爭議，主要源自AI及高頻寬記憶體(HBM)需求大增，帶動公司營運與獲利創下新高，但部分台灣員工認為獎金及分紅制度未充分反映公司獲利成長，希望公司調整現行獎酬機制。
美光桃園、台中兩地工會合計代表約1萬名員工，相較美光在兩地約1.5萬名員工，占比約三分之二；工會8月進行的內部調查中，超過八成參與會員支持罷工行動，使勞資爭議迅速升溫。
工會主要訴求聚焦獲利分享制度，希望獎金能與公司獲利建立更直接且透明的連結。工會除提出2026財年一次性獎金訴求，也要求自2027財年起，將營業利益一定比例作為員工獎金並改採季度發放，而非現有制度。
由於台灣是美光全球重要製造基地，更在今年買下力積電(6770-TW)銅鑼廠擴大生產，尤其涉及DRAM及高階記憶體供應，在目前AI伺服器、HBM與記憶體市場供給本已偏緊的背景下，罷工消息也引起國際市場高度關注。
美光今日最新聲明指出，公司與桃園工會已進行正式調解會議，雙方雖尚未達成共識，但已規畫召開第二次調解會議，希望延續實質對話。美光並感謝桃園市政府在調解過程中的協助，以及各方建設性的溝通與參與。
美光也再次將焦點放在員工獎酬上。公司表示，今年亮眼的營運表現，來自台灣及全球團隊成員的投入與貢獻，未來將持續傾聽員工想法，透過具競爭力的薪酬、績效獎勵、全球職涯發展機會，以及更多參與、分享公司長期發展成果的方式，支持並回饋員工。
美光先前即曾強調，今年預計發放公司歷年最高的績效獎金，相關IPP（Incentive Pay Plan）方案預計於10月公布；如今再度釋出將公布更多獎勵內容的訊息，也被視為公司在正式調解程序展開後，進一步回應員工訴求。
不過，首場調解最終仍未形成共識，也意味罷工警報尚未完全解除。依目前進度，勞資雙方將進入第二輪調解，後續美光提出的獎勵及分紅方案能否縮小雙方差距，將成為事件是否進一步升高的關鍵。
此次美光勞資爭議也正值全球記憶體產業獲利快速攀升之際。AI伺服器需求推升DRAM與HBM需求，包括三星、SK海力士及美光等主要記憶體廠營運同步受惠，也使員工如何分享AI景氣紅利，逐漸成為全球記憶體大廠新的勞資課題。美光台灣此次協商結果，後續不只牽動公司內部，也可能成為市場觀察記憶體產業獎酬制度的重要指標。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) faces an escalating labor dispute in Taiwan. On the 4th, Micron held a formal mediation with the Taoyuan union; the first round of talks did not reach an agreement, but a second mediation meeting has been scheduled to continue substantive dialogue. Confronted with employee demands to reform bonus and profit‑sharing schemes, Micron reiterated its commitment to competitive pay and performance rewards and announced that additional incentive details will be disclosed in the next few weeks, with the market watching to see if the looming strike risk can be further diffused.

The dispute in Taiwan has flared recently as demand for AI and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) has surged, driving Micron’s operations and profits to record highs. Some Taiwanese staff, however, say the current bonus and dividend system does not adequately reflect the company’s profit growth and are calling for adjustments to the compensation framework.

Unions in Micron’s Taoyuan and Taichung plants together represent about 10,000 workers, roughly two‑thirds of Micron’s roughly 15,000 employees in the two locations. An internal union poll in August showed that more than 80% of participating members support strike action, quickly intensifying the labor conflict.

The unions’ main demand centers on profit‑sharing, seeking a more direct and transparent link between bonuses and company earnings. They are asking for a one‑time bonus for fiscal year 2026 and, starting in fiscal year 2027, a fixed percentage of operating profit to be paid to employees on a quarterly basis, replacing the existing scheme.

Taiwan is a key manufacturing hub for Micron, which this year acquired Powerchip’s (6770‑TW) Tongluo fab to expand production, especially for DRAM and high‑end memory. With AI servers, HBM and memory markets already tight, strike rumors have attracted heightened attention from international markets.

Micron’s latest statement said the company and the Taoyuan union have held a formal mediation meeting. Although no agreement was reached, a second meeting is planned to keep substantive dialogue going. Micron thanked the Taoyuan city government for its assistance in the mediation and praised the constructive communication from all parties.

Micron again emphasized employee compensation. The company noted that this year’s strong operating performance stems from the contributions of teams in Taiwan and worldwide, and pledged to keep listening to staff, offering competitive salaries, performance bonuses, global career development opportunities, and more ways for employees to participate in and share the company’s long‑term growth.

Micron previously highlighted that it expects to award its highest ever performance bonuses this year, with the related Incentive Pay Plan (IPP) to be announced in October. The new signal that further incentive details will be released is seen as a response to employee demands following the start of formal mediation.

Nevertheless, the first mediation ended without consensus, meaning the strike alert has not been fully lifted. With a second round of talks imminent, whether Micron’s forthcoming bonus and profit‑sharing proposals can narrow the gap will be crucial to whether the dispute escalates further.

The Micron labor dispute comes as the global memory industry enjoys rapidly rising profits. AI‑driven server demand is boosting DRAM and HBM needs, benefitting major memory makers such as Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. How employees share the AI‑driven boom is becoming a new labor issue for memory giants worldwide, and the outcome of Micron’s Taiwan negotiations could serve as a key benchmark for compensation practices in the sector.

items.title: 目標價320元！小摩重申「增持」輝達：瓶頸在「供給」 先進晶圓與HBM是緊箍咒
items.title_en: Target Price $320! JPMorgan Reiterates "Buy" on Nvidia: Bottleneck Lies in "Supply"—Advanced Wafer and HBM Are a Tight Constraint
paras: 摩根大通(下稱小摩)分析師Harlan Sur在與輝達投資關係團隊會後重申「增持」評等，並維持320美元目標價，核心判斷在於輝達當前成長瓶頸不在需求，而是在供應。輝達管理層明言，若產能限制解除，業務規模可同比翻倍以上。
輝達給出2028財年年增約70%​的框架，但Sur認為，按現有客戶需求強度，潛在增速將更猛，輝達管理層提前揭示2028財年展望，是因為內部判讀與華爾街預測存在明顯落差，也讓台積電、HBM供應鏈提早排產。
需求來源已不只靠少數超大型雲端業者，像是超大规模雲端服務商、新興AI雲(neoclouds)、AI 實驗室、主權 AI、企業本地部署五路並進，客群分散度提升。
Sur指出，大約18個月前，訓練／推理比率大約各佔一半，如今推理在資料中心業務佔比明顯拉高，且隨著模型從訓練轉上線續增，因Blackwell同套硬體訓推通用，精確切分不易，但「訓練卡」變「長期推理資產」拉長了折舊週期。
輝達管理層告訴小摩：「營收上限取決於可交付晶片數。先進晶圓與HBM仍是緊箍咒，這也是為何問題從『有無需求』轉向『供不供得出』。」
小摩這份紀要重點不在數字多亮眼，而是在定性轉向，也就是在AI基礎建設週期裡，輝達的風險表已從需求端翻到供應端。
paras_en: JPMorgan (JPM) analyst Harlan Sur, after meeting with Nvidia's investor relations team, reiterated a "Buy" rating and kept a $320 price target, arguing that Nvidia's current growth bottleneck is supply, not demand. Nvidia’s management said that if capacity constraints are lifted, the business could more than double year‑over‑year.

Nvidia has outlined a roughly 70% annual growth framework for fiscal 2028, but Sur believes that, given the strength of existing customer demand, the potential acceleration could be even stronger. The early FY2028 outlook was disclosed because internal expectations diverge sharply from Wall Street forecasts, prompting TSMC and the HBM supply chain to schedule production ahead of time.

Demand now comes from more than just a handful of hyperscale cloud providers; it is spreading across ultra‑large cloud services, emerging AI clouds (neoclouds), AI labs, sovereign AI initiatives, and on‑premise enterprise deployments, diversifying the customer base.

Sur noted that about 18 months ago the split between training and inference workloads was roughly 50/50. Today inference occupies a noticeably larger share of data‑center revenue, and as models move from training to production the line blurs—Blackwell’s unified hardware handles both—but "training cards" are turning into long‑term inference assets, extending the depreciation period.

Nvidia’s management told JPMorgan, "Revenue upside is capped by the number of chips we can deliver. Advanced wafers and HBM remain the tight constraint, which is why the question has shifted from ‘is there demand?’ to ‘can we supply enough?’"
JPMorgan’s meeting notes focus less on flashy numbers and more on a qualitative shift: in the AI infrastructure cycle, Nvidia’s risk profile has moved from the demand side to the supply side.

items.title: 巴克萊：股市對能源價格與升息敏感度回升 恐加劇秋季波動
items.title_en: Barclays: Stock Market Sensitivity to Energy Prices and Rate Hikes Revives, Raising Risk of Autumn Volatility
paras: 根據巴克萊銀行的最新報告，全球股市對利率與能源價格波動的敏感度已再度上升。在充滿變數的9月份，聯準會的動向與原油價格，預計將成為主導市場走向的關鍵催化劑。
由於美伊持續對峙，原油價格再度走高，同時，歐洲天然氣價格也創下2023年初以來的新高，儘管仍遠低於2022年俄烏能源危機時的峰值。由Emmanuel Cau領銜的巴克萊策略師團隊指出，高企且持續時間拉長的能源價格，正進一步加劇通膨與利率的上行壓力。
隨著通膨居高不下，加上前聯準會理事華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾發表鷹派言論，市場目前預期Fed在9月升息的機率約為三分之二，巴克萊經濟學家也因此修正了預測，認為今年將再升息兩次(分別於9月和12月)。
此外，預計歐洲央行本月也將再升息一次。巴克萊團隊指出：「若能源價格維持高位且停滯性通膨疑慮升溫，上行風險將隨之增加。」
不過，考量到美國經濟活動已有放緩跡象，許多鷹派預期可能已反映在價格中，後續公佈的非農就業報告與消費者物價指數(CPI)將是重要的檢驗指標。
雖然強勁的企業獲利，先前緩衝了緊縮金融環境對股市的衝擊，但此一支持力道正在消退。Cau的團隊指出，隨著第二季獲利潮的尾風已過，總體經濟因素重回主導地位，股市近期對利率與油價波動變得更加敏感。
展望秋季，面對各國央行決策、美國期中選舉、習川會以及地緣政治風險等密集行程，市場波動可能加劇。對此，巴克萊策略師建議，在年底前利率與油價穩定、大局仍具支撐力的前提下，進行避險並「戰術性降低Beta曝險，看來是審慎的做法」。
paras_en: According to Barclays Bank’s latest report, global equity markets’ sensitivity to interest‑rate and energy‑price fluctuations has risen again. In a variable‑filled September, the Fed’s moves and crude‑oil prices are expected to be the key catalysts shaping market direction.

Because the US‑Iran standoff continues, crude oil prices have climbed again, while European natural‑gas prices have hit a new high since early 2023, though still well below the peak seen during the 2022 Russia‑Ukraine energy crisis. Barclays strategists led by Emmanuel Cau note that persistently high energy prices are further intensifying inflation and upward pressure on rates.

With inflation remaining elevated and former Fed governor Kevin Warsh delivering hawkish remarks at Jackson Hole, the market now estimates roughly a two‑thirds probability of a Fed rate hike in September. Barclays economists have therefore revised their outlook, expecting two more hikes this year – in September and December.

In addition, the European Central Bank is expected to raise rates once more this month. The Barclays team cautions that “if energy prices stay high and concerns about sticky inflation warm, upside risks will increase.”

However, given signs that US economic activity is already slowing, many hawkish expectations may already be priced in; the upcoming non‑farm payrolls and Consumer Price Index releases will be key gauges.

Although strong corporate earnings have so far buffered the impact of a tightening financial environment on equities, that support is waning. Cau’s team points out that with the tail‑end of the Q2 earnings wave behind us, macro‑economic factors are back in control, making stocks more sensitive to rate and oil‑price moves recently.

Looking ahead to autumn, with a packed agenda of central‑bank decisions, the US mid‑term elections, the Xi‑Xi meeting, and geopolitical risks, market volatility could intensify. Barclays strategists suggest that, assuming rates and oil prices stabilize and the broader backdrop remains supportive through year‑end, hedging and “tactically reducing beta exposure” appears to be a prudent approach.

items.title: Lululemon二度下修財測，瑜伽褲銷售大減20%、盤後股價重挫17%
items.title_en: Lululemon Revises Financial Outlook Again, Yoga Pants Sales Drop 20%, After‑Hours Stock Plummets 17%
paras: 2026年09月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 運動服飾品牌Lululemon(LULU-US)再度下修2026會計年度財測，北美需求疲弱、新品表現不如預期，加上核心瑜伽褲銷售明顯下滑，最新財測公布後，盤後股價一度重挫17%至100.18美元，今年截至週四收盤累計跌幅達42%。
Lululemon目前預估全年營收103.5億至105億美元，低於原估110億至111.5億美元；每股盈餘也由10.95至11.15美元，下修至9.48至9.73美元，已是今年第二度調降財測。
第二季營收年減率4%至24.2億美元，美洲營收下降8%，同店銷售下滑9%。其中，招牌女性瑜伽褲銷售年減率約20%，跌幅超過預期，反映消費者正轉向較寬鬆版型，目前Groove Wide-Leg等新品成長仍不足以完全填補缺口。
中國大陸市場也明顯降溫，第二季營收雖成長4%，但固定匯率下下降2%，同店銷售衰退8%。管理層指出，品牌負面輿論及天貓618活動變化影響流量，公司目前預估全年中國大陸營收僅成長高個位數。
更大的壓力可能出現在第三季。公司預估營收22.9億至23.2億美元，年減率10%至11%，每股盈餘僅0.93至0.98美元，遠低於去年同期2.59美元；營業利益率更預估由17%降至約6.5%。
面對需求降溫，Lululemon開始縮減展店，今年全球淨新增門市目標由約40家降至35家，北美門市SKU也已減少15%，同時增加熱銷商品追單與品牌行銷投入。隨新任執行長Heidi O'Neill即將上任，市場焦點將落在核心產品調整、北美需求修復，以及品牌能否重新吸引消費者。

paras_en: September 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Athletic apparel brand Lululemon (LULU-US) has once again lowered its fiscal 2026 outlook. Weak demand in North America, disappointing new‑product performance, and a sharp decline in core yoga‑pant sales prompted the revision, and the stock fell as much as 17% in after‑hours trading to $100.18, marking a cumulative decline of 42% year‑to‑date through Thursday’s close.

Lululemon now projects full‑year revenue of $10.35 billion to $10.5 billion, down from the prior estimate of $11.0 billion to $11.15 billion. Earnings per share have been cut from $10.95‑$11.15 to $9.48‑$9.73, representing the company’s second forecast downgrade this year.

Second‑quarter revenue fell 4% year‑over‑year to $2.42 billion, with Americas revenue down 8% and comparable store sales slipping 9%. Sales of its flagship women’s yoga pants declined about 20% year‑over‑year, a larger drop than expected, indicating consumers are shifting toward looser fits; growth from new styles such as Groove Wide‑Leg has not been sufficient to close the gap.

The mainland China market also cooled noticeably. Although second‑quarter revenue grew 4% in nominal terms, it fell 2% when adjusted for a fixed exchange rate, and comparable store sales declined 8%. Management said negative brand sentiment and changes in the Tmall 618 shopping event have hurt traffic, and the company now expects full‑year China revenue to grow only in the high single‑digit range.

Even greater pressure may arise in the third quarter. The company forecasts revenue of $2.29 billion to $2.32 billion, a year‑over‑year decline of 10%‑11%, with earnings per share of just $0.93‑$0.98, far below last year’s $2.59. Operating margin is projected to fall from 17% to roughly 6.5%.

Facing the cooling demand, Lululemon is scaling back store expansion, cutting its global net new‑store target for the year from about 40 to 35 locations, and reducing North American store SKUs by 15%. At the same time, the company is increasing replenishment of best‑selling items and boosting brand‑marketing spend. With new CEO Heidi O’Neill set to take the helm, market focus will shift to core‑product adjustments, recovery of North American demand, and whether the brand can win back consumers.
