items.title: 野村：極端情境下 日本最快今年底前連三次升息
items.title_en: Nomura: In Extreme Scenarios the BOJ Could Raise Rates Three Times Before Year‑End
paras: 野村證券預測，若日元持續走弱，在最極端的情境下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)可能一路到12月的三次會議上都將接連升息。
野村日本外匯策略主管Yujiro Goto表示，日銀9月升息1碼(25個基點)「看起來合理」，「如果日元走弱的動能持續，朝160日元兌1美元方向發展，那麼10月與12月也可能連續升息」。
他的談話凸顯市場對日銀政策預期所出現的戲劇性轉變。直到不久前，日銀仍以審慎步調推動貨幣政策正常化，如今市場卻開始押注可能加快緊縮腳步。
在市場預期日銀將加速升息，並揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的情況下，日元兌美元本周已升值逾2%，來到約156。
隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場顯示，交易員已幾乎篤定日銀9月會升息1碼，並押注明年1月前還會再升息一次。
日銀總裁植田和男先前曾暗示，日銀可能在即將召開的會議上採取行動。而央行內部立場數一數二鷹派的委員高田創(Hajime Takata) ，也並未排除一次較大幅度升息，以及連續升息的可能性。
日元周四(3日)成為外匯市場焦點，當天兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日歷史性聯手干預匯市短短數日。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160整數關卡，也就是被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
不過，若真的連續三次會議升息，對過去30年大部分時間都在對抗通縮、並將借貸成本維持在接近零水準的日銀而言，將代表極為罕見的快速緊縮步調。
Goto的基本預測情境則沒有如此激進。他預期，日銀未來每季至少升息一次的可能性或必要性很高，目前對日元匯價預測仍維持在154。
Goto表示，日本政府對貨幣政策的態度，可能是決定日元漲勢能否持續的關鍵。投資人正關注日本首相高市早苗是否會釋出支持日本銀行進一步緊縮政策的訊號，因為她過去曾對升息表達保留態度。
Goto說：「如果高市仍對日本銀行升息表達負面態度，市場將感到失望，日元可能再度遭到拋售。」
反之，如果高市早苗避免對貨幣政策表態，或強調日銀的獨立性，Goto認為，日元有機會升破150日元兌1美元。
美國聯準會(Fed)的政策也可能成為另一項催化劑。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，若接下來公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他將傾向在Fed下一次貨幣政策會議上主張維持利率不變。
Goto認為，從近期Fed官員的談話來看，美國可能不急於在9月升息。
交易員目前預期，Fed決策官員9月15-16日開會時升息的機率約為54%，低於華勒發表談話前的約62%。
假如Fed維持利率不變，而日銀釋出鷹派訊號，美元可能重新走弱，日元可能比投資人預期更早升破155。Goto表示，這將進一步支撐日元走強。
paras_en: Nomura Securities forecasts that if the yen continues to weaken, in the most extreme scenario the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could raise rates at all three meetings through December.

Nomura’s head of Japanese FX strategy, Yujiro Goto, said a 25‑basis‑point hike in September "looks reasonable" and that if yen weakness persists toward ¥160 per dollar, hikes in October and December are also possible.

His comments highlight a dramatic shift in market expectations for BOJ policy. Until recently the BOJ was moving cautiously toward monetary‑policy normalisation, but markets are now betting on a faster tightening pace.

With markets expecting the BOJ to accelerate hikes and speculating that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its portfolio, the yen has appreciated more than 2% against the dollar this week to around ¥156.
The overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders are almost certain of a 25‑basis‑point hike in September and are betting on another hike before January next year.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has previously hinted that the central bank may act at the upcoming meeting, and hawkish board member Hajime Takata has not ruled out a larger‑than‑usual hike or consecutive hikes.
The yen was the focus of the FX market on Thursday (the 3rd), briefly reaching ¥155.30 per dollar, the highest since August 3, just days after a historic joint US‑Japan intervention in the market.

Earlier this week the yen slipped past the ¥160 whole‑number barrier, a level the Tokyo authorities closely monitor for possible intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation ran rampant among investors.

If the BOJ were to raise rates at three consecutive meetings, it would represent an unusually rapid tightening for a central bank that has spent most of the past 30 years fighting deflation and keeping borrowing costs near zero.

Goto’s baseline scenario is less aggressive. He expects a high likelihood or even necessity that the BOJ will raise rates at least once each quarter, and he still forecasts the yen around ¥154 per dollar.

Goto said the Japanese government’s stance on monetary policy could be decisive for the yen’s upward momentum, and investors are watching whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will signal support for further BOJ tightening, as she has previously expressed reservations about rate hikes.
"If Takaichi continues to voice a negative view on BOJ rate hikes, the market will be disappointed and the yen could be sold off again," Goto said.
Conversely, if Takaichi avoids commenting on policy or stresses the BOJ’s independence, Goto believes the yen could break above ¥150 per dollar.

U.S. Federal Reserve policy could also act as a catalyst. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that if upcoming data confirm cooling inflation pressures, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged at the next Fed meeting.
Goto thinks recent Fed officials’ remarks suggest the United States is unlikely to rush a September rate hike.
Traders currently estimate about a 54% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, down from roughly 62% before Waller’s comments.

If the Fed holds rates steady while the BOJ signals hawkishness, the dollar could weaken again and the yen might appreciate beyond investors’ expectations, possibly breaking above ¥155, which Goto says would further support yen strength.

items.title: 微軟財報改版 Azure季營收首揭露 分析師這樣看
items.title_en: Microsoft Revamps Earnings Report, Azure Quarterly Revenue Disclosed for the First Time, Analysts Weigh In
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，對於想要了解微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)如何從AI獲益的投資人來說，現在可能會輕鬆一些。
根據微軟周三(3日)向美國證券管理委員會(SEC)提交的一份投資人簡報，考量到公司目前對AI的重視，微軟正在調整不同事業部門的財報呈現方式。
微軟未來將採用兩大事業部門：一個命名為「Agents and Infra」，另一個稱為「Devices and Consumer」。此前公司共有三大事業部門，分別為「Productivity and Business Processes」、「Intelligent Cloud」以及「More Personal Computing」。
這項改變不只是重新調整財報項目的分類。Bernstein分析師Mark Moerdler表示，在新的架構下，微軟Azure雲端運算業務將會被「更明確的揭露」，而這「考量到Azure業務的規模，以及它對公司和客戶的重要性，是合理的」。
StoneX分析師認為Yi Fu Lee，新的揭露架構「早就該推出」，也更符合微軟在AI時代的營運方式。
Lee表示，「投資人長期以來都希望能更透明的了解Azure，而新的呈現方式朝這個方向邁出重要一步。」
Moerdler認為，微軟新的財報架構將有助於投資人以更加「清楚」的方式解讀Azure雲端業務的表現，甚至比主要競爭對手將專業服務及其他業務一併納入雲端事業的做法更加清楚。
Moerdler指出，新的Azure營收拆分方式「應有助於投資人更清楚掌握這項關鍵業務」。
不過，微軟的新財報架構並不會直接揭露Azure業務中有多少營收來自AI相關業務。但Moerdler表示，他和團隊「理解為何這個數字很難單獨拆分」，除非微軟只計算與GPU相關的Azure營收。
這位Bernstein分析師也指出，隨著微軟將GitHub Cloud移出Azure的財報架構，並改列入「Microsoft Commercial Cloud」類別，Azure的營收成長率將會略微放緩。
微軟執行長Satya Nadella在簡報中寫道，「毫無疑問，AI代表了科技與商業領域的一場深刻轉變。它正在改變我們打造產品的方式以及營運方式，同時模糊產品之間的界線，並重新塑造我們的商業模式。」
他進一步表示，「為了反映這些變化，並提高財報對投資人的透明度，我們正在更新財務報告方式，使其反映公司的營運方式、資源配置方式，以及未來發展方向。」
StoneX的Lee認為，微軟正在「AI技術主要的價值創造層級來重新組織業務」，而不是「透過以往以產品為基礎的業務部門來管理公司」。
這項調整是在微軟於2024年底修改財報分類方式後，再一次進行的架構調整。
微軟股價周四上漲2.7%，至每股510.12美元。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that investors looking to understand how Microsoft (MSFT-US) benefits from AI may now find it easier.

According to a investor presentation Microsoft filed with the U.S. SEC on Wednesday the 3rd, the company is adjusting the way it presents financials across its business units to reflect its current focus on AI.

Microsoft will move to two primary segments going forward: one called “Agents and Infra” and the other “Devices and Consumer.” Previously the company reported three segments – “Productivity and Business Processes,” “Intelligent Cloud,” and “More Personal Computing.”

The change is more than a re‑classification of line items. Bernstein analyst Mark Moerdler said that under the new structure Microsoft’s Azure cloud business will be disclosed “more clearly,” which “given Azure’s scale and its importance to the company and its customers, is reasonable.”
StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee said the new disclosure framework “should have been introduced long ago” and better aligns with Microsoft’s operating model in the AI era.
Lee added, “Investors have long wanted greater transparency into Azure, and the new presentation is an important step in that direction.”

Moerdler believes the new reporting layout will help investors interpret Azure’s performance in a “clearer” way, even clearer than the approach of major rivals that bundle professional services and other businesses into the cloud segment.
Moerdler noted that the new Azure revenue split “should help investors more clearly grasp this critical business.”

However, Microsoft’s new reporting structure will not directly reveal how much of Azure’s revenue comes from AI‑related activities. Moerdler said he and his team “understand why that number is hard to isolate” unless Microsoft only tallies GPU‑related Azure revenue.

The Bernstein analyst also pointed out that as Microsoft moves GitHub Cloud out of the Azure reporting framework and into a “Microsoft Commercial Cloud” category, Azure’s revenue growth rate will likely slow slightly.

CEO Satya Nadella wrote in the presentation, “There is no doubt that AI represents a profound transformation for technology and business. It is changing how we build products and operate, blurring the lines between products and reshaping our business models.”
He added, “To reflect these changes and increase transparency for investors, we are updating our financial reporting to mirror how the company operates, allocates resources, and where it is headed.”
StoneX’s Lee said Microsoft is reorganizing its business around the primary value‑creation layers of AI technology rather than managing the company through traditional product‑based units.
The adjustment follows a previous overhaul of Microsoft’s reporting classifications at the end of 2024, marking another structural tweak.
Microsoft’s shares rose 2.7% on Thursday to $510.12 per share.

items.title: 「末日博士」魯比尼不擔心債券拋售潮：殖利率主要是因AI榮景推升
items.title_en: ‘Doomsday Doctor’ Roubini Unconcerned About Bond Sell‑off: Yields Driven Mainly by AI Boom
paras: 曾在2008年全球金融海嘯期間因精準預言災難而聞名的經濟學家魯比尼(Nouriel Roubini)，周五(4日)接受彭博電視台訪問，對近期債券市場的劇烈波動發表了相當樂觀的看法。
魯比尼指出，近期長天期債券殖利率上升的最大驅動力，主要是由於對人工智慧繁榮和強勁的私人信貸需求的樂觀情緒，而不是更廣泛的經濟危機。
相較於過去的悲觀論調，魯比尼近年展現出較為溫和與晴朗的態度。他解釋，債券殖利率上升往往是經濟強勁成長的信號。當市場進入「冒險模式(risk-on)」、經濟成長力道強勁時，通常會伴隨股市上漲以及債券殖利率走高。
儘管美國公共債務規模在近期首度突破40兆美元，且債券殖利率攀升至2008年以來的最高點，魯比尼並不否認財政隱憂，但他強調，全球經濟已走出「大停滯」與近乎通貨緊縮的陷阱。
魯比尼表示，目前全球債券殖利率處於高位，是因為全球通膨率不再是零，而是維持在接近2%的合理運作區間，這意味著各國經濟已迎來投資與成長的新時代。
儘管他坦承市場仍面臨多重下行風險，包括荷姆茲海峽的局部封鎖、中東衝突升溫的隱憂、各國財政整頓可能衝擊國內需求，以及可能存在的AI泡沫化，但他認為這些多為常見的干擾因素，部分修正無可避免。
魯比尼強調，全球正處於實質性的全球投資榮景中，這將顯著提升生產力並帶動經濟成長。因此，他對整體的經濟前景抱持著相當樂觀的態度。
paras_en: Economist Nouriel Roubini, who became famous during the 2008 global financial crisis for accurately predicting the disaster, told Bloomberg Television on Friday (the 4th) that he is quite optimistic about the recent extreme volatility in the bond market.

Roubini said the biggest driver behind the recent rise in long‑term bond yields is optimism about a flourishing artificial‑intelligence sector and strong private‑credit demand, not a broader economic crisis.

Compared with past pessimistic narratives, Roubini has shown a milder and brighter outlook in recent years. He explained that rising bond yields often signal robust economic growth; when markets shift into a ‘risk‑on’ mode and growth is strong, equities usually rise together with bond yields.

Even though U.S. public debt has just broken the $40 trillion mark for the first time and yields have climbed to their highest level since 2008, Roubini does not deny fiscal concerns but stresses that the global economy has emerged from a ‘great stagnation’ and near‑deflationary trap.

Roubini said current global bond yields are high because global inflation is no longer zero but hovering around a reasonable 2% range, indicating that economies worldwide have entered a new era of investment and growth.

He acknowledged that markets still face multiple downside risks—including a localized closure of the Hormuz Strait, escalating Middle‑East tensions, fiscal tightening that could curb domestic demand, and a possible AI bubble—but he views these as typical disruptions, some correction of which is inevitable.

Roubini emphasized that the world is in a genuine global investment boom that will markedly boost productivity and drive economic growth, so he remains considerably optimistic about the overall economic outlook.

items.title: 川普想救晶片供應鏈卻害慘美國工廠？600人飯碗恐不保
items.title_en: Trump Aims to Rescue Chip Supply Chain but May Harm U.S. Factories? About 600 Jobs at Risk
paras: 美國川普政府為強化本土半導體供應鏈祭出的新貿易措施，恐怕適得其反。《路透》周五(4日)援引知情人士消息報導，德國化工大廠瓦克化學(Wacker Chemie)位於田納西州查爾斯頓的多晶矽工廠，在政策公布後流失僅存的兩家客戶，目前正面臨關閉風險，約600名員工的生計也可能受到波及。
據了解，瓦克化學預計未來幾周內決定是否關閉這座工廠，但《路透》目前無法確認兩家客戶的身分。瓦克化學也未就客戶流失或潛在關廠計畫置評。這座工廠原本是華府希望保護的關鍵設施之一，如今卻可能成為川普政府貿易政策下的受害者。
這也成為川普貿易政策未能有效扶植目標產業的最新案例。先前美國對鋼鐵與鋁材加徵關稅，一度推高美國汽車製造商的成本並削弱其對抗進口車的能力，直到政府採取額外措施後才有所緩解。
政策未獎勵美國原料 反讓客戶轉身離開
白宮上月發布公告，希望藉由貿易措施鼓勵業者採購美國製多晶矽。相關措施於8月6日公布，將自12月起生效，包括對進口多晶矽錠、晶圓、太陽能電池與面板設定最低價格及加徵關稅。
問題在於，現行規則對海外製造的產品一體適用，不論使用的是美國或中國多晶矽，待遇都沒有差別，並未給予美國原料額外優惠。根據市場研究機構Bernreuter Research資料，美國多晶矽價格最高可達外國產品的4倍，現行制度等於讓本土產品的成本劣勢繼續存在，也難以鼓勵客戶改用美國原料。
瓦克化學表示，目前評估政策對公司業務的影響仍言之過早，但直言依照現行條文，相關措施「無法有效支持使用美國製多晶矽」。公司正與川普政府積極協商，希望找出真正能達成保護本土生產商目標的做法。
Wood Mackenzie分析師皮爾斯(Elissa Pierce)也指出，依照目前設計，市場並不預期《貿易擴張法》第232條關稅能夠帶動美國多晶矽需求。反而是與中國存在關聯、總部位於阿曼的海外競爭對手United Solar Polysilicon，對這項措施表示歡迎。
抗中政策恐適得其反 600人工作面臨威脅
這起事件也令人質疑，川普政府能否真正保護美國半導體供應鏈，避免中國擴大主導地位。中國企業長期稱霸太陽能級多晶矽市場，近年更逐步進軍純度要求更高的半導體級多晶矽領域。
主張關稅及產業政策的美國繁榮聯盟(Coalition for a Prosperous America)指出，美國目前僅有兩家公司生產多晶矽，政府制定執行規則時，應明確獎勵採購美國產品。
該組織發言人艾科維拉(Nick Iacovella)警告，若政府不能明確釋出訊號，確立本土多晶矽是太陽能與半導體供應鏈的基礎，美國恐將這兩個產業拱手讓給外國競爭對手及中國等敵對國家，構成直接的國家安全威脅。
美國商務部未回應置評要求。川普政府官員則表示，政府仍持續與產業利害關係人溝通，以完善多晶矽製造回流美國的策略。公告也授權商務部向投資美國多晶矽產能的企業提供獎勵，但相關條件必須與個別企業逐案協商。
除了瓦克化學，Hemlock Semiconductor是美國僅存的另一家多晶矽製造商，但受到新措施的衝擊相對有限。Hemlock母公司康寧(GLW-US)會採購其生產的太陽能級多晶矽，並在美國國內進一步製成晶圓，因此較不依賴其他客戶需求。
瓦克化學在美國與德國的業務近年均飽受中國競爭衝擊，去年已在耗資25億美元興建的查爾斯頓工廠裁員。執行長哈特爾(Christian Hartel)在政策公布前數日便曾向投資人警告，若期待中的貿易措施無法帶來實質助益，公司可能「多了一座工廠」。
paras_en: The Trump administration's new trade measures to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain may backfire, Reuters reported on Friday (the 4th) that Wacker Chemie’s polysilicon plant in Charleston, Tennessee is losing its last two customers after the policy announcement and now faces closure, putting roughly 600 employees' livelihoods at risk.

Wacker Chemie expects to decide within the next few weeks whether to shut the plant, but Reuters could not confirm the identities of the two customers. The company did not comment on the customer loss or any potential shutdown plan. The plant was originally one of the key facilities Washington hoped to protect, yet it may become a victim of the Trump administration’s trade policy.

This adds to the growing list of examples where Trump’s trade policies have failed to effectively support target industries. Earlier U.S. tariffs on steel and aluminum once drove up costs for American automakers and weakened their ability to compete with imported cars, only easing after the government took additional steps.
The policy does not reward U.S. raw materials, instead prompting customers to walk away

Last month the White House announced a trade measure intended to encourage companies to buy U.S.-made polysilicon. The measures, unveiled on August 6, will take effect in December and include minimum price floors and tariffs on imported polysilicon ingots, wafers, solar cells and panels.

The problem is that the current rules apply uniformly to overseas‑made products, regardless of whether they contain U.S. or Chinese polysilicon, offering no extra advantage to U.S. material. According to market‑research firm Bernreuter Research, U.S. polysilicon can cost up to four times as much as foreign products, so the existing regime leaves a cost disadvantage for domestic producers and does little to persuade customers to switch to U.S. material.

Wacker Chemie said it is still too early to assess the policy’s impact on its business, but bluntly noted that under the current wording the measures “cannot effectively support the use of U.S.-made polysilicon.” The company is actively negotiating with the Trump administration to find a truly protective approach for domestic manufacturers.

Wood Mackenzie analyst Elissa Pierce also pointed out that, as designed, the market does not expect the Section 232 tariff under the Trade Expansion Act to boost U.S. polysilicon demand. Instead, overseas competitor United Solar Polysilicon, which is linked to China and headquartered in Oman, welcomed the measure.
Anti‑China policies may backfire, threatening 600 jobs

The episode raises doubts about whether the Trump administration can truly safeguard the U.S. semiconductor supply chain and keep China from expanding its dominance. Chinese firms have long dominated the solar‑grade polysilicon market and have recently moved into the higher‑purity, semiconductor‑grade segment.

The Coalition for a Prosperous America, which advocates tariffs and industrial policy, notes that only two companies in the United States produce polysilicon and that the government’s implementation rules should explicitly reward purchases of U.S. products.

Coalition spokesperson Nick Iacovella warned that if the government does not send a clear signal that domestic polysilicon is the foundation of the solar and semiconductor supply chains, the U.S. could hand both industries over to foreign competitors and hostile nations like China, creating a direct national‑security threat.

The U.S. Commerce Department did not respond to requests for comment. Trump officials said the government continues to engage with industry stakeholders to refine a strategy for bringing polysilicon manufacturing back to the United States. The announcement also authorizes the Commerce Department to offer incentives to firms that invest in U.S. polysilicon capacity, though the terms must be negotiated case‑by‑case with each company.

Besides Wacker Chemie, Hemlock Semiconductor is the only other U.S. polysilicon producer, but it is less affected by the new measures. Hemlock’s parent Corning (GLW‑US) purchases its solar‑grade polysilicon and further processes it into wafers domestically, making it less dependent on external customer demand.

Wacker Chemie’s U.S. and German operations have both been hit hard by Chinese competition in recent years. Last year the company cut staff at the $2.5 billion Charleston plant it built. CEO Christian Hartel warned investors days before the policy rollout that if the expected trade measures fail to deliver real benefits, the company could end up with “one more factory.”

items.title: 川習會有戲了？傳習近平罕見帶企業高層赴美談生意
paras: 中國國家主席習近平正準備於本月訪問華府時，率領一支大型企業代表團同行。知情人士表示，在美國對中國投資抱持高度疑慮、北京與民營企業關係仍顯緊張之際，這項安排並不尋常，可能意在向美方釋出支持投資及商業往來的訊號。
《路透》周五(4日)獨家報導，習近平預定9月24日與美國總統川普舉行峰會，隨行企業代表團的安排先前並未曝光，目前尚無法確認哪些中國企業高層將會參加。
一名了解討論內容的消息人士表示，中方希望藉此表明推動美中投資與商業關係的意願，同時在美國期中選舉前，為白宮提供一些可以對外宣傳的經濟成果。

罕見率大型企業團訪美 上次已是2015年

習近平鮮少帶著企業高層出訪，尤其北京自2020年起對科技、教育及房地產等產業展開監管整頓後，不少民營企業家一度失去官方青睞。
他上一次率領大規模企業代表團訪美是在2015年，成員包括阿里巴巴(09988-HK)(BABA-US)創辦人馬雲、騰訊(00700-HK)創辦人馬化騰，以及中國銀行與國營企業高層。
訪問期間，中國簽署採購300架波音(BA-US)飛機、總值380億美元的協議；習近平也與蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)、Meta(META-US)執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)等美國科技界領袖會面。
相較之下，川普過去訪中時經常率領大型美國企業代表團，包括2017年及今年5月的行程。今年5月隨行的18名美國企業高層，包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳及特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克。
華府智庫戰略暨國際研究中心(CSIS)中國商業專家甘思德(Scott Kennedy)表示，中方這次似乎將更有意識地安排企業高層參與代表團，這些人的加入可能相當有價值。他並認為，美方5月的企業代表團籌組倉促，企業高層與其說是重要參與者，更像是站在一旁陪襯。

峰會突破預期有限 聚焦貿易機制與稀土出口

儘管中方安排大型企業代表團，但消息人士對峰會成果仍持審慎態度。美中5月宣布建立管理雙邊貿易與投資關係的正式機制，不過由於美國對中國投資的環境仍充滿挑戰，投資委員會不太可能在峰會期間提出重大成果。
雙方對貿易委員會可納入哪些「非敏感」產品仍有分歧，目前正在討論約10類商品，但最終範圍可能在峰會前調整。美方此次峰會的主要目標之一，是就貿易委員會達成協議，並替美國企業爭取更多中國稀土出口許可。
美國官員表示，川普政府仍持續要求中國履行雙方去年10月於釜山達成的協議。該協議促成為期一年的貿易休戰，暫停部分出口管制與關稅措施。北京則要求美方進一步降低關稅，中國商務部7月透露，雙方正研究針對價值300億美元商品相互調降關稅。
美國最高法院2月推翻依《國際緊急經濟權力法》對中國加徵的關稅後，華府隨後推出10%的全球進口關稅。美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)周四透露，兩國將在峰會期間就農業及非關稅壁壘發布若干消息，但未說明細節。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)、葛里爾與中國國務院副總理何立峰預計9月初會面，討論峰會可能取得的成果，確切時間與地點目前尚未確定。

items.title: 歐股迎來秋季契機？花旗分析師：最壞時期已過 循環股浮現投資價值
items.title_en: European Stocks Face Autumn Opportunity? Citi Analyst: The Worst Phase Is Over, Cyclical Stocks Show Investment Value
paras: 花旗集團歐洲股權策略主管Beata Manthey指出，在經歷一段艱難時期後，與經濟健康狀況密切相關的歐洲循環類股，迎來了具吸引力的進場點。隨著經濟數據改善與政策支持，部分受創最重的歐洲產業可能已度過最壞階段。
花旗的經濟驚奇指數、廣泛產業的盈餘修正以及夏季回升的商業活動，均顯示歐洲正朝著正確的方向邁進。
Manthey在彭博電視專訪中表示：「秋季是進入循環類股的極佳時機。」她指出，雖然投資人仍需採取精挑細選的策略，但整體而言最壞時期或許已過去，投資人應考慮撤銷其「減碼」配置。
目前歐洲決策者正積極採取措施保護本土產業，使其免受美中競爭的夾擊，其中汽車和化工行業可能已熬過最艱難的時期。
她表示，以鋼鐵為例，歐洲新推出的鋼鐵關稅成功推高了歐盟內部價格，使避開稅項的歐洲製造商受益，展現了保護主義如何轉化為歐洲的優勢。這類透過「購買歐洲貨」(優先採購)與針對性關稅的作法，有助於建立歐洲的經濟韌性。
儘管如此，此論點的主要風險仍在於能源價格。工業部門若要獲得真正的實質助力，能源價格需持續下跌，但地緣政治局勢至今阻礙了這一點。
在配置上，花旗目前看好歐洲本土股票，而非曝險於國際市場的出口商與消費性品牌。
paras_en: Citi Group Europe equity strategy head Beata Manthey said that after a tough period, European cyclical stocks, which are closely tied to economic health, have reached an attractive entry point. With improving economic data and policy support, some of the hardest‑hit European industries may have passed their worst stage.
Citi’s economic surprise index, earnings revisions across sectors, and the summer rebound in business activity all indicate that Europe is moving in the right direction.

Manthey told Bloomberg TV, “Autumn is an excellent time to get into cyclical stocks.” She noted that while investors still need to be selective, overall the worst period may be behind us and investors should consider lifting their “underweight” positions.

European policymakers are now actively taking steps to protect domestic industries from the squeeze of U.S.–China competition, with the auto and chemicals sectors possibly having weathered their toughest phase.

She said, taking steel as an example, the newly introduced EU steel tariffs have pushed up prices within the bloc, benefiting European manufacturers that can avoid the duties and showing how protectionism can become a European advantage. Such “buy‑European” procurement and targeted tariffs help build economic resilience in Europe.

Nevertheless, the main risk to this view remains energy prices. For the industrial sector to receive real support, energy costs must keep falling, but geopolitical tensions have so far prevented that.
In terms of allocation, Citi currently favors European‑home stocks over exporters and consumer brands that are exposed to international markets.

items.title: 美債再迎新利空！挪威主權基金擬砍政府債權重至50% 減持美債約800億美元
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Face New Headwinds as Norway's Sovereign Fund Plans to Cut Government Bond Weight to 50% and Reduce U.S. Treasury Holdings by About $80 Billion
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，全球最大主權財富基金「挪威銀行投資管理公司(NBIM)」已正式去函挪威財政部，建議將基金基準債券指數中政府債券的權重從目前的70%大幅下調至50%。
《金融時報》報導，上述調整若獲通過，將削減NBIM約1060億美元的全球政府債券配置，其中絕大部分來自美債，減持規模約800億美元。目前，NBIM管理的挪威主權財富基金總規模高達2.3兆美元，其中近26%資金配置於固定收益產品。
NBIM在信函中解釋，50%的政府債券份額已經足以滿足流動性需求，包括在金融市場動盪時期的變現要求。剩餘額度將轉向能提供更多風險溢價的資產，主力是房利美與房地美等美國政府支持機構擔保的抵押貸款證券(MBS)。這類MBS信用品質接近美債，但因存在提前還款風險，殖利率略高於同天期國債。配置調整後，英債佔比不變，日債增加2.8個百分點，美元部位僅微降0.5個百分點。
NBIM發言人強調，這封信僅為「建議」，最終決定需待財政部於2027年春季向議會提交方案。
此項提議出台之際，全球債市正承受雙重壓力：一方面，各國政府債務水平攀升，今年來全球債券拋售潮未歇；另一方面，美伊戰爭爆發加劇通膨擔憂，能源成本上漲令長端殖利率承壓。
儘管美國財長貝森特今夏多次干預美債市場，殖利率仍處於多年高位。ING美洲區研究主管Padhraic Garvey指出，能源衝擊並非暫時現象，其背後的結構性變化可能持續推高通膨。
與此同時，滙豐(HSBC)上調對美債殖利率的全曲線預測，該行美國利率策略師Dhiraj Narula表示，由於預期貨幣政策路徑將更偏鷹派，且長期殖利率的結構性下限抬高，因此將今年底對2年期美債殖利率預測值，從3.85%上調至4.20%，明年底亦從3.5%上調至3.95%；10年期年底預測值從4.3%上調至4.65%，明年底則看4.75%。
英國CG資產管理公司投資組合經理Emma Moriarty認為，全球經濟已從通縮動能轉向通膨動能，關稅與中東戰事正是這一秩序轉變的直接體現。
挪威主權基金的提議與匯豐的預測調整，在同一天形成呼應，傳統大買家開始要求更高的風險溢價，賣方則將殖利率底部整體上移。
在挪威財政部拍板前，800億美元的減持計畫仍是非約束性提議，但長期資金「去無風險化」的佈局思路已清晰浮現。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the world’s largest sovereign wealth fund, Norway’s Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM), has formally written to the Norwegian Ministry of Finance recommending that the fund’s benchmark bond index reduce the weight of government bonds from the current 70% to 50%.

The Financial Times says that if the adjustment is approved, NBIM will cut about $106 billion of its global government‑bond allocation, the vast majority of which is U.S. Treasuries, amounting to a reduction of roughly $80 billion. NBIM manages Norway’s sovereign wealth fund of about $2.3 trillion, with nearly 26% allocated to fixed‑income products.

In the letter NBIM explains that a 50% share of government bonds is sufficient to meet liquidity needs, even during market turbulence. The remaining allocation will be shifted to assets that can provide a higher risk premium, chiefly agency mortgage‑backed securities (MBS) guaranteed by U.S. government‑supported entities such as Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. These MBS have credit quality close to Treasuries but carry prepayment risk, so their yields are slightly higher than comparable‑maturity sovereign bonds. After the rebalancing, the share of UK gilts stays unchanged, Japanese bonds rise by 2.8 percentage points and the dollar‑denominated portion falls only 0.5 percentage points.
NBIM’s spokesperson stressed that the letter is merely a “recommendation” and that the final decision will await the Ministry of Finance’s proposal to parliament in the spring of 2027.

The proposal comes as global bond markets bear a double strain: on the one hand, sovereign debt levels are climbing and the wave of bond sell‑offs that began this year has not abated; on the other, the outbreak of a U.S.–Iran conflict is heightening inflation concerns, with rising energy costs pressuring long‑term yields.

Even though U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has repeatedly intervened in the Treasury market this summer, yields remain at multi‑year highs. ING’s Americas research head Padhraic Garvey notes that the energy shock is not a temporary event and that the underlying structural shift could keep inflation elevated.

At the same time, HSBC has raised its full‑curve Treasury yield forecasts. HSBC U.S. rates strategist Dhiraj Narula said that a more hawkish monetary‑policy path and a higher structural floor for long‑term yields justify lifting the year‑end 2‑year Treasury yield forecast from 3.85% to 4.20% and the next‑year forecast from 3.5% to 3.95%; the 10‑year year‑end forecast is lifted from 4.3% to 4.65% and the next‑year outlook to 4.75%.

Emma Moriarty, portfolio manager at UK‑based CG Asset Management, believes the global economy has shifted from deflationary to inflationary momentum, with tariffs and Middle‑East conflicts being direct manifestations of this new order.

The Norwegian sovereign‑fund proposal and HSBC’s forecast adjustments echo each other on the same day, signalling that traditional large buyers are demanding higher risk premiums while sellers are pushing the overall yield floor upward.

Before the Norwegian Ministry of Finance makes a final decision, the $80 billion reduction remains a non‑binding proposal, but the long‑term “de‑risking” strategy of capital is already becoming clear.

items.title: 美汽車游說團體促國會年底前立法 禁用中國聯網車與軟硬體
items.title_en: US Automotive Lobbying Group Urges Congress to Pass Year‑End Legislation Banning Chinese Connected Cars and Their Software and Hardware
paras: 代表通用(GM-US)、福特(F-US)、豐田、福斯(Volkswagen)等主要車廠的「汽車創新聯盟」(Alliance for Automotive Innovation)已向美國國會發出呼籲，要求在今年會期結束前，盡速通過立法，永久禁止中國車輛進入美國市場。
汽車創新聯盟執行長John Bozzella在致國會的信函中指出，中國汽車製造商正向全球傾銷受補貼並配備聯網軟硬體的車輛。雖然此現象尚未在美國國內發生，但鑑於此一威脅的規模與緊迫性，他敦促國會於今年底休會前，將「禁用中國車輛、軟體及硬體」立法化，以國家安全手段應對中國企圖主導全球汽車製造的策略。
這一禁令主要源於國家安全考量，因為車輛搭載的藍牙、Wi-Fi、蜂窩網路及衛星通訊技術，可能使車主的敏感數據遭到收集。
對此，中國駐美大使館表示反對，並強調北京已取消外資製造業的准入限制，且持續對國際車廠開放，並指出特斯拉、別克、豐田和福特在中國皆是家喻戶曉的品牌。
然而，這項立法目前仍面臨重重挑戰。雖然參議院商務委員會已於7月批准相關加強禁令的法案，但委員會主席Ted Cruz指出，草案中規定「持股超15%中資實體將面臨禁用」的條款，會導致擁有近20%中資被動股權的賓士(Mercedes-Benz)在美禁售，法案必須修正才能走入立法程序。
另外，今年6月，Polestar表示，川普政府正迫使這家電動車製造商從2027年車型開始，停止在美國銷售汽車。這家總部位於瑞典的公司目前由中國吉利控股集團控股。
paras_en: The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, representing major automakers such as General Motors (GM‑US), Ford (F‑US), Toyota and Volkswagen, has appealed to the U.S. Congress to pass legislation before the end of the current session to permanently prohibit Chinese vehicles from entering the U.S. market.

Alliance CEO John Bozzella wrote to Congress stating that Chinese car manufacturers are dumping subsidized vehicles equipped with connected software and hardware worldwide. Although this phenomenon has not yet occurred domestically, he said the scale and urgency of the threat warrant a national‑security response, urging lawmakers to codify a ban on Chinese cars, software and hardware before the year‑end recess.
The proposed ban is driven primarily by national‑security concerns, as vehicles’ Bluetooth, Wi‑Fi, cellular and satellite communications could allow sensitive driver data to be collected.

China’s embassy in Washington responded with opposition, emphasizing that Beijing has lifted foreign‑investment restrictions in manufacturing and continues to welcome international automakers, noting that Tesla, Buick, Toyota and Ford are all well‑known brands in China.

The legislation still faces significant hurdles. Although the Senate Commerce Committee approved a stronger ban in July, committee chair Ted Cruz warned that a provision barring entities with more than 15% Chinese ownership would force a near‑20% passive Chinese stake in Mercedes‑Benz to be prohibited in the U.S., requiring amendment before the bill can proceed.

In June, Polestar said the Trump administration was pressuring the Swedish electric‑vehicle maker—now controlled by China’s Geely Holding Group—to stop selling cars in the United States starting with its 2027 model year.

items.title: 美光首輪勞資調解無共識 數周內將公布更多獎勵細節
items.title_en: Micron’s First Labor Mediation Session Ends Without Agreement; More Incentive Details to Be Released in Coming Weeks
paras: 美光(MU-US)於台灣的勞資爭議持續延燒。美光今(4)日與桃園工會進行正式調解，雙方首輪協商尚未達成共識，但已規畫召開第二次調解會議，延續實質對話。面對員工要求改革獎金及盈餘分享制度，美光也進一步釋出善意，除重申將以具競爭力薪酬、績效獎勵回饋員工，更預告未來幾周內將公布更多獎勵細節，市場關注能否進一步化解潛在罷工危機。
美光近期在台爆發勞資爭議，主要源自AI及高頻寬記憶體(HBM)需求大增，帶動公司營運與獲利創下新高，但部分台灣員工認為獎金及分紅制度未充分反映公司獲利成長，希望公司調整現行獎酬機制。
美光桃園、台中兩地工會合計代表約1萬名員工，相較美光在兩地約1.5萬名員工，占比約三分之二；工會8月進行的內部調查中，超過八成參與會員支持罷工行動，使勞資爭議迅速升溫。
工會主要訴求聚焦獲利分享制度，希望獎金能與公司獲利建立更直接且透明的連結。工會除提出2026財年一次性獎金訴求，也要求自2027財年起，將營業利益一定比例作為員工獎金並改採季度發放，而非現有制度。
由於台灣是美光全球重要製造基地，更在今年買下力積電(6770-TW)銅鑼廠擴大生產，尤其涉及DRAM及高階記憶體供應，在目前AI伺服器、HBM與記憶體市場供給本已偏緊的背景下，罷工消息也引起國際市場高度關注。
美光今日最新聲明指出，公司與桃園工會已進行正式調解會議，雙方雖尚未達成共識，但已規畫召開第二次調解會議，希望延續實質對話。美光並感謝桃園市政府在調解過程中的協助，以及各方建設性的溝通與參與。
美光也再次將焦點放在員工獎酬上。公司表示，今年亮眼的營運表現，來自台灣及全球團隊成員的投入與貢獻，未來將持續傾聽員工想法，透過具競爭力的薪酬、績效獎勵、全球職涯發展機會，以及更多參與、分享公司長期發展成果的方式，支持並回饋員工。
美光先前即曾強調，今年預計發放公司歷年最高的績效獎金，相關IPP（Incentive Pay Plan）方案預計於10月公布；如今再度釋出將公布更多獎勵內容的訊息，也被視為公司在正式調解程序展開後，進一步回應員工訴求。
不過，首場調解最終仍未形成共識，也意味罷工警報尚未完全解除。依目前進度，勞資雙方將進入第二輪調解，後續美光提出的獎勵及分紅方案能否縮小雙方差距，將成為事件是否進一步升高的關鍵。
此次美光勞資爭議也正值全球記憶體產業獲利快速攀升之際。AI伺服器需求推升DRAM與HBM需求，包括三星、SK海力士及美光等主要記憶體廠營運同步受惠，也使員工如何分享AI景氣紅利，逐漸成為全球記憶體大廠新的勞資課題。美光台灣此次協商結果，後續不只牽動公司內部，也可能成為市場觀察記憶體產業獎酬制度的重要指標。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) faces an escalating labor dispute in Taiwan. On the 4th, Micron held a formal mediation with the Taoyuan union; the first round of talks did not reach an agreement, but a second mediation meeting has been scheduled to continue substantive dialogue. Confronted with employee demands to reform bonus and profit‑sharing schemes, Micron reiterated its commitment to competitive pay and performance rewards and announced that additional incentive details will be disclosed in the next few weeks, with the market watching to see if the looming strike risk can be further diffused.

The dispute in Taiwan has flared recently as demand for AI and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) has surged, driving Micron’s operations and profits to record highs. Some Taiwanese staff, however, say the current bonus and dividend system does not adequately reflect the company’s profit growth and are calling for adjustments to the compensation framework.

Unions in Micron’s Taoyuan and Taichung plants together represent about 10,000 workers, roughly two‑thirds of Micron’s roughly 15,000 employees in the two locations. An internal union poll in August showed that more than 80% of participating members support strike action, quickly intensifying the labor conflict.

The unions’ main demand centers on profit‑sharing, seeking a more direct and transparent link between bonuses and company earnings. They are asking for a one‑time bonus for fiscal year 2026 and, starting in fiscal year 2027, a fixed percentage of operating profit to be paid to employees on a quarterly basis, replacing the existing scheme.

Taiwan is a key manufacturing hub for Micron, which this year acquired Powerchip’s (6770‑TW) Tongluo fab to expand production, especially for DRAM and high‑end memory. With AI servers, HBM and memory markets already tight, strike rumors have attracted heightened attention from international markets.

Micron’s latest statement said the company and the Taoyuan union have held a formal mediation meeting. Although no agreement was reached, a second meeting is planned to keep substantive dialogue going. Micron thanked the Taoyuan city government for its assistance in the mediation and praised the constructive communication from all parties.

Micron again emphasized employee compensation. The company noted that this year’s strong operating performance stems from the contributions of teams in Taiwan and worldwide, and pledged to keep listening to staff, offering competitive salaries, performance bonuses, global career development opportunities, and more ways for employees to participate in and share the company’s long‑term growth.

Micron previously highlighted that it expects to award its highest ever performance bonuses this year, with the related Incentive Pay Plan (IPP) to be announced in October. The new signal that further incentive details will be released is seen as a response to employee demands following the start of formal mediation.

Nevertheless, the first mediation ended without consensus, meaning the strike alert has not been fully lifted. With a second round of talks imminent, whether Micron’s forthcoming bonus and profit‑sharing proposals can narrow the gap will be crucial to whether the dispute escalates further.

The Micron labor dispute comes as the global memory industry enjoys rapidly rising profits. AI‑driven server demand is boosting DRAM and HBM needs, benefitting major memory makers such as Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron. How employees share the AI‑driven boom is becoming a new labor issue for memory giants worldwide, and the outcome of Micron’s Taiwan negotiations could serve as a key benchmark for compensation practices in the sector.

items.title: 目標價320元！小摩重申「增持」輝達：瓶頸在「供給」 先進晶圓與HBM是緊箍咒
items.title_en: Target Price $320! JPMorgan Reiterates "Buy" on Nvidia: Bottleneck Lies in "Supply"—Advanced Wafer and HBM Are a Tight Constraint
paras: 摩根大通(下稱小摩)分析師Harlan Sur在與輝達投資關係團隊會後重申「增持」評等，並維持320美元目標價，核心判斷在於輝達當前成長瓶頸不在需求，而是在供應。輝達管理層明言，若產能限制解除，業務規模可同比翻倍以上。
輝達給出2028財年年增約70%​的框架，但Sur認為，按現有客戶需求強度，潛在增速將更猛，輝達管理層提前揭示2028財年展望，是因為內部判讀與華爾街預測存在明顯落差，也讓台積電、HBM供應鏈提早排產。
需求來源已不只靠少數超大型雲端業者，像是超大规模雲端服務商、新興AI雲(neoclouds)、AI 實驗室、主權 AI、企業本地部署五路並進，客群分散度提升。
Sur指出，大約18個月前，訓練／推理比率大約各佔一半，如今推理在資料中心業務佔比明顯拉高，且隨著模型從訓練轉上線續增，因Blackwell同套硬體訓推通用，精確切分不易，但「訓練卡」變「長期推理資產」拉長了折舊週期。
輝達管理層告訴小摩：「營收上限取決於可交付晶片數。先進晶圓與HBM仍是緊箍咒，這也是為何問題從『有無需求』轉向『供不供得出』。」
小摩這份紀要重點不在數字多亮眼，而是在定性轉向，也就是在AI基礎建設週期裡，輝達的風險表已從需求端翻到供應端。
paras_en: JPMorgan (JPM) analyst Harlan Sur, after meeting with Nvidia's investor relations team, reiterated a "Buy" rating and kept a $320 price target, arguing that Nvidia's current growth bottleneck is supply, not demand. Nvidia’s management said that if capacity constraints are lifted, the business could more than double year‑over‑year.

Nvidia has outlined a roughly 70% annual growth framework for fiscal 2028, but Sur believes that, given the strength of existing customer demand, the potential acceleration could be even stronger. The early FY2028 outlook was disclosed because internal expectations diverge sharply from Wall Street forecasts, prompting TSMC and the HBM supply chain to schedule production ahead of time.

Demand now comes from more than just a handful of hyperscale cloud providers; it is spreading across ultra‑large cloud services, emerging AI clouds (neoclouds), AI labs, sovereign AI initiatives, and on‑premise enterprise deployments, diversifying the customer base.

Sur noted that about 18 months ago the split between training and inference workloads was roughly 50/50. Today inference occupies a noticeably larger share of data‑center revenue, and as models move from training to production the line blurs—Blackwell’s unified hardware handles both—but "training cards" are turning into long‑term inference assets, extending the depreciation period.

Nvidia’s management told JPMorgan, "Revenue upside is capped by the number of chips we can deliver. Advanced wafers and HBM remain the tight constraint, which is why the question has shifted from ‘is there demand?’ to ‘can we supply enough?’"
JPMorgan’s meeting notes focus less on flashy numbers and more on a qualitative shift: in the AI infrastructure cycle, Nvidia’s risk profile has moved from the demand side to the supply side.

items.title: 印尼盾有望連續第五周上漲 寫兩年來最長連漲紀錄
items.title_en: Indonesian Rupiah Poised for Fifth Consecutive Week of Gains, Setting Two-Year Longest Winning Streak
paras: 印尼盾近日表現強勁，預計將迎來連續第五周上漲，創下兩年來最長的周度連漲走勢。
印尼盾兌美元匯率在周五(4日)亞市早盤交易中報 17,628，持續徘徊在 17,650 附近，本周美元兌印尼盾預計下跌 0.4%，有望創下自 5 月 20 日以來的最低收盤價格。
此波強勢上漲主要受到內外部因素的雙重支撐。其中，外部環境改善，市場因聯準會(Fed)官員的鴿派言論，調降了本月的升息預期。美債殖利率的回落與美元的走弱，皆為印尼盾提供了顯著的短期支撐。
內部政策也有助維持穩定，印尼央行承諾維護匯率穩定。新任印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti釋放了政策延續性的訊號，強調政策以穩定為先，並透過綜合政策助力經濟成長、維持對境外投資人的吸引力。她也提到，目前國內通膨仍處於受控狀態。
然而，市場分析也指出潛在的制約因素。華僑銀行外匯策略師 Christopher Wong 提醒，高油價與持續高企的全球殖利率依舊是潛在風險。此外，聖嬰現象(El Niño)可能干擾食品供應並推高物價，加上市場在下周公布 8 月外匯存底、消費者信心和 7 月零售銷售等數據前持謹慎態度，皆可能使後續漲勢增添變數。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah has been performing strongly recently and is expected to record a fifth consecutive week of gains, marking the longest weekly rally in two years.

The rupiah’s exchange rate against the US dollar was reported at 17,628 in early Asian market trading on Friday (the 4th), hovering around the 17,650 level. This week the dollar is projected to fall 0.4% against the rupiah, potentially delivering the lowest closing price since May 20.

The robust rise is driven by a dual boost of external and internal factors. Externally, the environment has improved as Fed officials’ dovish remarks have lowered market expectations for rate hikes this month. Falling US Treasury yields and a weaker dollar have provided significant short‑term support for the rupiah.

Domestically, policy measures are helping maintain stability. The Bank of Indonesia has pledged to keep the exchange rate steady. New governor Destry Damayanti signaled policy continuity, emphasizing stability as the priority and using a comprehensive policy mix to support growth and retain foreign investor appeal. She also noted that domestic inflation remains under control.

However, analysts point to potential headwinds. OCBC’s FX strategist Christopher Wong warned that high oil prices and persistently elevated global yields remain risks. Additionally, the El Niño phenomenon could disrupt food supplies and push prices higher, and market participants are cautious ahead of next week’s releases of August foreign‑exchange reserves, consumer confidence and July retail sales data, which could add uncertainty to further gains.

items.title: 野村：極端情境下 日本最快今年底前連三次升息
items.title_en: Nomura: In Extreme Scenarios the BOJ Could Raise Rates Three Times Before Year‑End
paras: 野村證券預測，若日元持續走弱，在最極端的情境下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)可能一路到12月的三次會議上都將接連升息。
野村日本外匯策略主管Yujiro Goto表示，日銀9月升息1碼(25個基點)「看起來合理」，「如果日元走弱的動能持續，朝160日元兌1美元方向發展，那麼10月與12月也可能連續升息」。
他的談話凸顯市場對日銀政策預期所出現的戲劇性轉變。直到不久前，日銀仍以審慎步調推動貨幣政策正常化，如今市場卻開始押注可能加快緊縮腳步。
在市場預期日銀將加速升息，並揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的情況下，日元兌美元本周已升值逾2%，來到約156。
隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場顯示，交易員已幾乎篤定日銀9月會升息1碼，並押注明年1月前還會再升息一次。
日銀總裁植田和男先前曾暗示，日銀可能在即將召開的會議上採取行動。而央行內部立場數一數二鷹派的委員高田創(Hajime Takata) ，也並未排除一次較大幅度升息，以及連續升息的可能性。
日元周四(3日)成為外匯市場焦點，當天兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日歷史性聯手干預匯市短短數日。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160整數關卡，也就是被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
不過，若真的連續三次會議升息，對過去30年大部分時間都在對抗通縮、並將借貸成本維持在接近零水準的日銀而言，將代表極為罕見的快速緊縮步調。
Goto的基本預測情境則沒有如此激進。他預期，日銀未來每季至少升息一次的可能性或必要性很高，目前對日元匯價預測仍維持在154。
Goto表示，日本政府對貨幣政策的態度，可能是決定日元漲勢能否持續的關鍵。投資人正關注日本首相高市早苗是否會釋出支持日本銀行進一步緊縮政策的訊號，因為她過去曾對升息表達保留態度。
Goto說：「如果高市仍對日本銀行升息表達負面態度，市場將感到失望，日元可能再度遭到拋售。」
反之，如果高市早苗避免對貨幣政策表態，或強調日銀的獨立性，Goto認為，日元有機會升破150日元兌1美元。
美國聯準會(Fed)的政策也可能成為另一項催化劑。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，若接下來公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他將傾向在Fed下一次貨幣政策會議上主張維持利率不變。
Goto認為，從近期Fed官員的談話來看，美國可能不急於在9月升息。
交易員目前預期，Fed決策官員9月15-16日開會時升息的機率約為54%，低於華勒發表談話前的約62%。
假如Fed維持利率不變，而日銀釋出鷹派訊號，美元可能重新走弱，日元可能比投資人預期更早升破155。Goto表示，這將進一步支撐日元走強。
paras_en: Nomura Securities forecasts that if the yen continues to weaken, in the most extreme scenario the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could raise rates at all three meetings through December.

Nomura’s head of Japanese FX strategy, Yujiro Goto, said a 25‑basis‑point hike in September "looks reasonable" and that if yen weakness persists toward ¥160 per dollar, hikes in October and December are also possible.

His comments highlight a dramatic shift in market expectations for BOJ policy. Until recently the BOJ was moving cautiously toward monetary‑policy normalisation, but markets are now betting on a faster tightening pace.

With markets expecting the BOJ to accelerate hikes and speculating that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its portfolio, the yen has appreciated more than 2% against the dollar this week to around ¥156.
The overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders are almost certain of a 25‑basis‑point hike in September and are betting on another hike before January next year.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has previously hinted that the central bank may act at the upcoming meeting, and hawkish board member Hajime Takata has not ruled out a larger‑than‑usual hike or consecutive hikes.
The yen was the focus of the FX market on Thursday (the 3rd), briefly reaching ¥155.30 per dollar, the highest since August 3, just days after a historic joint US‑Japan intervention in the market.

Earlier this week the yen slipped past the ¥160 whole‑number barrier, a level the Tokyo authorities closely monitor for possible intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation ran rampant among investors.

If the BOJ were to raise rates at three consecutive meetings, it would represent an unusually rapid tightening for a central bank that has spent most of the past 30 years fighting deflation and keeping borrowing costs near zero.

Goto’s baseline scenario is less aggressive. He expects a high likelihood or even necessity that the BOJ will raise rates at least once each quarter, and he still forecasts the yen around ¥154 per dollar.

Goto said the Japanese government’s stance on monetary policy could be decisive for the yen’s upward momentum, and investors are watching whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will signal support for further BOJ tightening, as she has previously expressed reservations about rate hikes.
"If Takaichi continues to voice a negative view on BOJ rate hikes, the market will be disappointed and the yen could be sold off again," Goto said.
Conversely, if Takaichi avoids commenting on policy or stresses the BOJ’s independence, Goto believes the yen could break above ¥150 per dollar.

U.S. Federal Reserve policy could also act as a catalyst. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that if upcoming data confirm cooling inflation pressures, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged at the next Fed meeting.
Goto thinks recent Fed officials’ remarks suggest the United States is unlikely to rush a September rate hike.
Traders currently estimate about a 54% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, down from roughly 62% before Waller’s comments.

If the Fed holds rates steady while the BOJ signals hawkishness, the dollar could weaken again and the yen might appreciate beyond investors’ expectations, possibly breaking above ¥155, which Goto says would further support yen strength.

items.title: 全球利率預期轉向 亞洲貨幣周五普遍走強
items.title_en: Global rate expectations shift, Asian currencies broadly stronger on Friday
paras: 受到聯準會官員言論影響，全球利率預期有所轉變，帶動亞洲主要貨幣在周五普遍走強。
美國聯邦準備理事會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨持續放緩，他將支持本月維持利率不變。此番言論降溫了市場對9月升息的預期，使美元面臨壓力，美元指數本周預計下跌0.7%至99.06。市場目前正密切關注即將公佈的美國8月份非農就業報告。
在此背景下，日元表現尤受矚目，有望創下自7月底以來最強勁的單周表現，本周已經升值約2.5%。
雖然美元周五兌日元午盤上漲0.3%至156.36，但日元在盤中一度強彈至155.25，逼近7月美日聯合干預時的155.2水位。市場分析指出，日元這波升值並非源於官方直接干預，而是因為市場預期日本央行(BOJ)可能在9月17至18日的會議上採取更鷹派的立場。日本央行此前已在6月將政策利率提高至1%，市場正定價9月再次升息的極高可能性。
與此同時，其他亞太貨幣也各有波動。人民幣匯率保持平穩，受弱勢美元支撐，投資人正持續評估中國私營部門服務業數據與疲軟的官方經濟背景。紐西蘭元與澳元也跟隨央行與貿易訊號波動，美元兌紐元下跌0.3%至1.70左右(紐元約合0.59美元)，紐西蘭央行此前升息25個基點至2.75%；澳洲第二季經濟成長0.4%，澳元兌美元維持在0.72美元附近。
此外，馬來西亞央行周四宣布將基準利率維持在2.75%，美元兌馬來西亞令吉在決議後微幅上漲0.16%至4.04。韓元兌美元小幅升值0.05%，至1,355.65兌1美元，而印度盧比則延續了本周的升勢。
paras_en: Influenced by comments from Federal Reserve officials, global rate expectations have shifted, driving the main Asian currencies to broadly strengthen on Friday.

items.title: 17兆日元空單緊張！日元升破155恐引爆踩踏 匯率直奔142區間
items.title_en: 17 Trillion Yen Short Positions Tighten as Yen Surpasses 155 Threatens a Crash, Currency Heads Straight to 142 Range
paras: 摩根大通銀行(JPM-US) 策略師指出，若日元匯率升破155日元兌1美元的關鍵防線，規模龐大的日元空頭部位進一步回補，可能加速日元漲勢。
Junya Tanase等策略師在研究報告中寫道：「近期價格走勢似乎印證我們的看法，即市場可能仍持有相對龐大的日元空頭部位。」若美元兌日元跌破155，「不能排除賣壓引發更多賣盤，推動日元升幅超出預期的風險。」
摩根大通估計，目前市場尚未平倉的看空日元部位約達16兆至17兆日元（約1,026億美元），若這些部位全面回補，理論上可能將美元兌日元推低至142至146區間。
這項警告發布之際，日元剛經歷自7月底日本與美國聯手干預匯市以來最猛烈的漲勢之一。美元兌日元本周稍早一度升至160.39，創該次干預以來最高，隨後急遽反轉，最低跌至155.30，距離干預後低點155.23僅一步之遙。
這波強勁漲勢主要受到市場揣測日本國家退休金基金（GPIF）可能調整資產配置，以及日本央行將加快升息步伐的預期升溫所帶動。
市場觀察人士指出，投機性日元空單回補與日本國內投資人的避險需求，進一步放大這些利多因素，也提高日元續漲迫使更多空頭部位平倉的風險。
不過，摩根大通認為，市場對GPIF與日本央行的預期「似乎有些過度」，現階段並不認為美元兌日元大幅跌破其預估的155至165區間具有很高機率。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase analysts noted that if the yen breaks the critical 155 yen per dollar barrier, the massive short positions could be further closed, potentially accelerating the yen’s rise.

Junya Tanase and other strategists wrote in a research note that recent price action seems to confirm their view that the market may still hold a relatively large short yen position; if the dollar falls below 155 yen, "selling pressure could trigger more sales, pushing the yen higher than expected."

JPMorgan estimates that the market still has about 16 to 17 trillion yen (roughly $102.6 billion) of short yen positions open; if these are fully closed, the dollar could be pushed into the 142‑146 yen range.

At the time of this warning, the yen had just experienced one of the strongest rallies since the joint intervention by Japan and the United States at the end of July. The dollar‑yen pair briefly touched 160.39 earlier this week, the highest since the intervention, before sharply reversing and falling to a low of 155.30, just one point above the post‑intervention trough of 155.23.

The strong rally was mainly driven by market speculation that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) might adjust its asset allocation, coupled with expectations that the Bank of Japan would accelerate its rate‑hike pace.

Market observers pointed out that speculative short yen positions and domestic Japanese investors’ hedging demand further amplified these positive factors, increasing the risk that the yen’s continued rise would force more shorts to close.

However, JPMorgan believes that expectations around GPIF and the Bank of Japan are "seemingly somewhat over‑stretched," and at present does not see a high probability of the dollar‑yen falling sharply below the 155‑165 range it estimated.

items.title: USD/JPY：市場押注日本央行升息，日圓強勢升至一個月高點、美元兌日圓跌破157
items.title_en: USD/JPY: Market Bets on BOJ Rate Hikes, Yen Rallies to One-Month High, Dollar/Yen Falls Below 157
paras: 要點：

日圓強勢反彈，這次是真的嗎？
市場升息押注大幅升溫
接下來聚焦美國就業數據


日圓在兩個交易日內從1美元兌逾160日圓，大幅升值至約157日圓。接下來，週五公布的美國就業報告，將決定這波日圓反轉行情是否還有進一步的上漲空間。

日圓終於找到上漲動能


週四，usdjpy大跌1%，跌破157.00日圓，創下約一個月來最低水準。
日圓週三上漲約0.9%，讓原本看似又一次守住160日圓失敗的走勢，轉變為更值得關注的兩個交易日反轉行情。
日圓近期一度觸及164日圓附近的40年低點，之後美日罕見聯合干預，推動USD/JPY最低跌至155.20日圓。不過，這波漲勢後來大多數又遭到回吐。
從目前情況來看，最新一波日圓漲勢似乎是由利率預期轉變所支撐，而不只是政府拋售美元的結果。
稍早市場曾猜測日本當局再次進場干預，或進行「利率檢查」 — 也就是官員向銀行詢問即時匯率報價，有時會在正式進場干預市場前進行。
不過，分析師如今愈來愈傾向將這波走勢歸因於日本央行偏鷹派的訊號。這一次，日圓可能真的找到了自己的上漲燃料。


日本央行進一步轉向鷹派


日本央行審議委員高田創表示，利率應根據通膨情況靈活升調，而不是遵循可預測的每年兩次升息時程。
日本央行總裁植田和男則表示，經濟與物價風險將在9月會議上進行討論，這也意味著每一次政策會議都可能成為升息的時機。
市場目前幾乎已完全反映日本央行本月升息的預期，並預計截至年底前將累計升息約50個基點。
1個基點等於百分之一個百分點。日本兩年期政府公債殖利率週三升至1.83%，創1995年以來最高。
日本殖利率上升，會降低套利交易的吸引力 — 也就是以低利率借入日圓，再投資於殖利率較高的海外資產。
如果日本央行加快升息腳步，這類部位的獲利空間就會縮小，交易員可能因此平倉，進而被迫買回日圓。全球最受歡迎的融資貨幣，現在開始收取「入場費」了。


美國非農就業數據將決定另一邊的走向


週五公布的美國就業報告預計將顯示新增就業人數約56,000人。目前市場認為聯準會9月升息的機率約為60%。如果就業數據疲弱，升息預期可能降溫，美國公債殖利率下滑，進而推動USD/JPY進一步走低。
如果非農就業與薪資成長強勁，則可能支持聯準會主席Kevin Warsh的鷹派立場，並可能推動USD/JPY回升至159甚至160日圓。
目前的匯率走勢，本質上是兩種利率預期重新定價的角力：一方面是日本央行加快緊縮政策，另一方面則是聯準會可能再次升息。
目前值得關注的價位：157日圓是短線關鍵樞軸，其下方則關注156日圓附近的支撐，以及干預後的低點155.20日圓。
上方阻力則位於159與160日圓。若跌破157.50日圓，將進一步強化日圓的看跌美元／看漲日圓反轉走勢；若重新站回160日圓，則代表日圓這波反攻仍需要官方出手「助攻」。

paras_en: Key points:

The yen has rebounded strongly – is this time genuine? Market bets on rate hikes are heating up, and the focus now shifts to U.S. employment data. The yen appreciated sharply from over ¥160 per dollar to around ¥157 within two trading days. The upcoming U.S. jobs report on Friday will determine whether this yen reversal has further upside potential.

The yen finally found upward momentum. On Thursday, USD/JPY dropped 1% below ¥157, hitting its lowest level in about a month. After a 0.9% rise on Wednesday, the yen turned a seemingly failed defense of the ¥160 level into a notable two‑day reversal. The yen had earlier touched the 40‑year low near ¥164, prompting a rare joint intervention by the U.S. and Japan that pushed USD/JPY down to ¥155.20, though most of the rally was later given back. The latest yen rise appears driven by shifting rate expectations rather than merely government dollar sales. Earlier speculation that Japanese authorities might intervene again or conduct a “rate check” (officials asking banks for real‑time quotes before formal intervention) is giving way to analysts attributing the move to hawkish signals from the Bank of Japan. This time the yen may have truly found its fuel.
The Bank of Japan is turning more hawkish. Governor Kazuo Ueda’s deputy, Takada Sō, said rates should be adjusted flexibly according to inflation rather than following a predictable twice‑a‑year hike schedule. BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda noted that economic and price risks will be discussed at the September meeting, meaning each policy meeting could become a rate‑hike opportunity. The market has almost fully priced in a rate hike this month and expects about 50 basis points of cumulative hikes by year‑end. One basis point equals one‑hundredth of a percent. Japan’s two‑year government bond yield rose to 1.83% on Wednesday, the highest since 1995. Higher Japanese yields reduce the appeal of carry trades—borrowing yen at low rates to invest in higher‑yielding overseas assets. If the BOJ accelerates hikes, the profit space for such positions shrinks, prompting traders to unwind and buy back yen, turning the world’s favorite funding currency into one that now carries an “entry fee”.
U.S. non‑farm payrolls will decide the other side’s direction. Friday’s U.S. jobs report is expected to show about 56,000 new jobs. The market currently sees a roughly 60% chance of a Fed rate hike in September. Weak employment data could cool hike expectations, lower U.S. bond yields, and push USD/JPY further down. Strong payrolls and wage growth could support Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s hawkish stance and lift USD/JPY back to ¥159 or even ¥160. The current exchange‑rate move essentially reflects a re‑pricing battle between two rate expectations: a faster BOJ tightening versus a possible further Fed hike. Key levels to watch: ¥157 is a short‑term pivot, with support near ¥156 and the post‑intervention low of ¥155.20. Resistance lies at ¥159‑¥160. A break below ¥157.50 would reinforce a bearish USD/long‑yen reversal, while a return to ¥160 would suggest the yen’s rally still needs official “assist”.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元下跌 債市拋售降溫 日元飆至1個月高點
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Falls, Bond Market Sell‑off Cools, Yen Surges to One‑Month High
paras: 美元周四(3日)下跌，創逾兩周來最差單日表現，主要因美國公債殖利率下滑及日元強勁反彈。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.7%，報98.91。
美國公債殖利率下滑拖累美元。交易員在美債經歷一波劇烈拋售後開始逢低買進，帶動殖利率回落。美國10年期公債殖利率周二升至2023年11月以來最高，周四最新下跌3.3個基點至4.761%。
固定收益市場近期的拋售潮，主要受到多項因素推動，包括高油價引發的通膨疑慮、企業為建置AI基礎設施而大舉舉債可能造成的債務不可持續疑慮，以及政府財政債務持續膨脹。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)釋出的一些正面訊息，也有助於改善市場情緒。
華勒在接受Reuters NEXT訪問時準備的談話稿中表示，「雖然通膨仍明顯高於聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)設定的2%目標，但近期數據顯示，我們終於看到一些通膨降溫的跡象。如果未來兩周公布的數據持續呈現這種趨勢，我將傾向支持維持聯邦資金利率目前的水準。」
這名FOMC投票委員補充，他認為潛在通膨的表現其實遠優於核心通膨數據所呈現的情況。相較於聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行會議上的演講，華勒此次發言的語氣較不偏鷹。
Macquarie外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「如果目前主要央行再次形成一個共同趨勢，那就是貨幣政策應對供給衝擊引發的新一波通膨保持戒心。這可能是過去兩周聯準會、歐洲央行(ECB)、澳洲央行(RBA)、加拿大央行(BoC)及日本銀行紛紛採取較為鷹派立場時，最明確且最普遍的考量因素。」
「如果所有央行同時轉向鷹派，對外匯市場的影響仍難以確定。但在油價高漲的背景下，我們仍偏好美元相較於澳幣、歐元及英鎊的表現，原因在於稀缺石油的貿易條件優勢有利於美國。」
日元飆至1個月高點
日元周四成為外匯市場焦點。日元強勁反彈，兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日當局歷史性聯手干預匯市僅數日。包括這次具里程碑意義的聯合干預在內，日本從7月30日至8月26日合計動用創紀錄的15兆日元來支撐日元。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160日元兌1美元，這被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
布魯金斯研究院資深經濟研究員Robin Brooks表示，「日元隔夜的升值走勢具干預的所有典型特徵：日元急劇、垂直式升值，但日美利差並未同步擴大，無法從水準面解釋這樣的升幅。如果看起來像干預，那就是干預。」
除了可能的干預行動之外，本周日本銀行(BoJ)決策官員釋出的偏鷹訊號，也為日元提供支撐。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周日在北卡羅來納州舉行的G20會議期間，與日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)會面。貝森特當時「強烈支持日本採取果斷的市場與貨幣政策措施，以因應日元被大幅低估的問題」。
植田周二在一場會議上證實，日銀將在9月討論升息，此外，日銀委員高田創(Hajime Takata)進一步強化市場的升息預期，主張採取更靈活的升息路徑。
其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.4%，至1.1632美元。
即使歐盟統計局(Eurostat)公布數據顯示，歐元區7月工業生產者價格月增1.6%，歐元仍持續走高。這與6月月減0.3%的表現形成反差。
市場正等待歐洲央行下周的利率決策。目前市場一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。
加幣兌美元走強，美元兌加幣下跌0.4%，至1.3787。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Thursday (the 3rd), posting its worst single‑day performance in over two weeks, mainly due to a drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a strong rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.7% to 98.91.

Falling U.S. Treasury yields weighed on the dollar. After a sharp sell‑off in Treasuries, traders began buying on dips, pushing yields lower. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield, which had risen on Tuesday to its highest since November 2023, fell 3.3 basis points on Thursday to 4.761%.

The recent bond‑market sell‑off has been driven by several factors, including inflation worries sparked by high oil prices, concerns that corporate borrowing to build AI infrastructure could become unsustainable, and the continued expansion of government fiscal debt.
Positive remarks from Fed Governor Christopher Waller also helped improve market sentiment.

In a prepared statement for a Reuters NEXT interview, Waller said, "Although inflation remains clearly above the Federal Open Market Committee’s 2% target, recent data show that we are finally seeing some signs of cooling. If the data released over the next two weeks continue this trend, I would be inclined to support keeping the federal funds rate at its current level."

The voting FOMC member added that he believes underlying inflation is actually performing far better than core‑inflation figures suggest. Compared with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting last week, Waller’s tone was less hawkish.

Macquarie FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, "If the major central banks are again forming a common trend, it is that monetary policy should remain cautious toward a new wave of inflation triggered by supply shocks. This has been the clearest and most common consideration over the past two weeks as the Fed, ECB, RBA, BoC and BOJ have all taken relatively hawkish stances."

"If all central banks turn hawkish at the same time, the impact on FX markets is still uncertain. But against a backdrop of high oil prices, we still prefer the dollar over the Australian, euro and pound, because the trade‑flow advantage of scarce oil benefits the United States," he added.
The yen surged to a one‑month high

The yen became the focus of the FX market on Thursday, rallying sharply and briefly reaching 155.30 per dollar, the highest level since August 3, just days after historic joint intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities. Including this landmark coordinated intervention, Japan used a record 15 trillion yen from July 30 to August 26 to support the currency.

Earlier this week the yen had slipped past 160 per dollar, a level viewed by Tokyo as a key threshold for intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation among investors was rampant.

Brookings senior economist Robin Brooks said, "The yen’s overnight appreciation shows all the hallmarks of intervention: a rapid, vertical move while the U.S.–Japan rate differential did not widen, making the rise impossible to explain on fundamentals alone. If it looks like intervention, it is intervention."
In addition to possible intervention, hawkish signals from Bank of Japan policymakers this week also gave the yen support.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda during the G20 meeting in North Carolina on Sunday. Bessent said he "strongly supports Japan taking decisive market and monetary‑policy actions to address the yen’s significant undervaluation."

Ueda confirmed on Tuesday at a meeting that the BOJ will discuss a rate hike in September, and BOJ board member Hajime Takata further reinforced market expectations for tightening, advocating a more flexible path for future hikes.
Among other major currencies, the euro rose 0.4% against the dollar to $1.1632.
Even though Eurostat data showed a 1.6% month‑on‑month increase in July industrial producer prices in the euro area, the euro kept climbing, contrasting with a 0.3% decline in June.
Markets are awaiting the European Central Bank’s rate decision next week, with consensus expecting a 25‑basis‑point hike.
The Canadian dollar strengthened versus the dollar, with the USD/CAD pair down 0.4% at 1.3787.

items.title: 〈台幣〉與亞幣脫鉤！股匯齊挫 量縮連2黑收31.755元
items.title_en: TWD Decouples from Asian Currencies! Stocks and FX Both Fall, Volume Shrinks, Two Consecutive Red Days, Close at 31.755
paras: 台北股匯今(3)日走勢震盪，台股尾盤賣壓出籠收黑，新台幣兌美元先升後貶，一度摜破 31.8 元關卡，並未跟隨日元等亞幣走強，在央行出手調節下，終場貶勢收斂，收在 31.755 元，貶值 2.7 分，為連 2 黑，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值萎縮至 27.31 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.75 元，早盤最高升抵 31.70 元，但隨著熱錢流出，匯價最低來到 31.827 元，所幸尾盤靠央行介入穩匯，驚險收復 31.8 元關卡，以 31.755 元作收，貶值 2.7 分。
美伊緊張局勢升溫，再度掀起升息疑慮，台股今天尾盤急殺 307 點，失守46000點關卡，收在 45857.66 點，台積電、聯發科表現有撐，但記憶體、PCB 等電子族群賣壓沉重。三大法人合計賣超637.11億元，其中外資及陸資賣超481.46億元。
觀察主要亞幣今天對美元表現，日元強勢大漲 1.62%，韓元同步勁揚0.66%，星幣升值 0.33%，人民幣升值 0.06%，新台幣走勢獨憔悴，收盤下挫 0.09%。
日元日前一度貶破 160 兌 1 美元大關，隨後於 2 日急升至 158 字頭。隨著美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)近期公開敦促日本升息，市場人士解讀，160 關卡可能已成為美方與日本央行(BOJ)共同防守的新底線。日銀將於 9 月 17 日至 18 日召開貨幣政策會議，總裁植田和男面臨進退兩難局面，而市場目前已高度反映本月升息 1 碼的預期。
paras_en: Taipei's stock and FX markets were volatile today (the 3rd), with the Taiwan index ending the session in the red under selling pressure. The New Taiwan dollar rose against the US dollar before falling, briefly breaking the 31.8 level, and did not follow the rally in the yen and other Asian currencies. After the central bank intervened, the depreciation eased and the dollar closed at 31.755, down 2.7 cents, marking a second consecutive red day. Total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets shrank to $2.731 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.75 per US dollar, climbed to a high of 31.70 in early trading, but as hot money fled, the rate fell to a low of 31.827. Fortunately, central‑bank intervention near the close steadied the market, narrowly reclaiming the 31.8 barrier and finishing at 31.755, down 2.7 cents.

Rising US‑Iran tensions revived rate‑hike concerns, and the Taiwan index plunged 307 points in the final session, slipping below the 46,000 mark to close at 45,857.66. TSMC and MediaTek provided some support, but memory‑chip, PCB and other electronics sectors faced heavy selling. The three major institutional investors sold a combined NT$63.711 billion, with foreign and mainland investors accounting for NT$48.146 billion of the net outflow.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies against the dollar, the yen surged 1.62%, the won rose 0.66%, the Singapore dollar appreciated 0.33%, the renminbi gained 0.06%, while the New Taiwan dollar was the only one to weaken, closing down 0.09%.

The yen had briefly slipped past the 160 per dollar threshold before rallying sharply to the 158 range on the 2nd. After US Treasury official Scott Bessent publicly urged Japan to raise rates, market participants read that the 160 level may now serve as a new joint floor defended by the US and the Bank of Japan. The BOJ is set to hold its monetary policy meeting on September 17‑18, with Governor Kazuo Ueda facing a dilemma, and markets have already priced in a one‑percentage‑point rate hike this month.
